notes.title: News on the Upcoming Combat Update - Beta Content - Win a Steam Gift Card
notes.content:
Greetings scientists!

We’ve just pushed a massive amount of content and changes to our Beta Branch which you can now play for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/fb4c40fccd783ec8bb3dc006a0e6fd6e2537b6e7.gif[/img]

Some of you have noticed that this beta has lasted a little longer than previous ones. We’ve been cooking some changes to what we first released based on your initial feedback.

We also wanted to try reward players willing to come back and give us more feedback which you can read about below. So let's get into what we’ve been up to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/60c662c1703cc76bd8288887fc5358fdf3f99fcb.gif[/img]

[h2]WHY WE'RE TAKING MORE TIME WITH COMBAT[/h2]

Back in late July, we launched the beta for our next update. The overall sentiment from players was that it was fine and that we added some decent content to the overall game loop.

However, we felt we wanted to create something a little better than just "fine". We genuinely value and take into account player feedback so we saw this as another chance to truly show that. We went over all beta gameplay feedback again and together the team mapped out what additions and improvements could be made with an extra month of development time. 

We’ve made some massive changes and feel we’ve added some great features and changes not just to combat, but the whole game loop. 

[h2]WHAT IS BEING ADDED/CHANGED?[/h2]

The changes/additions we decided to implement can be sorted into 1 of 3 major categories:

[b]1. Combat Overhaul[/b]
[i]Improvements to Crossbow, ammo types and traps. Suit upgrades - armor and backpacks. Mantis has improved player tracking, logic with new attacks and animations, including a ranged attack.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/93c72547a3a7e92ee41ddf9b0e03958b05e59de1.gif[/img]

[b]2. New Locations Overhaul[/b] 
[i]Mantis “arena” completely revamped from scratch, expanding the size & scale of the area. Visual improvements made to both new locations, making them easier to navigate. New high-voltage gates added to locations.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/83e7c7656d3389294ff038c4de39eca628ce68f1.gif[/img]

[b]3. New Mechanic [/b](Scavengers Printer)
[i]A completely new mechanic/system was added to both new locations. Trade artifacts found in the world for others to complete your collection. Earn “Tech Sliver” to increase your Prestige and unlock new reward tiers.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/b9b510de05f27c4dd0df082f0e4d9dc4ff4dcc76.png[/img]

You can see the full breakdown in the patch notes further below.

[h2]SOME ADDITIONS TO THE BETA ARE WORK IN PROGRESS[/h2]

While playing the beta you will notice that some elements are whiteboxes/missing textures, which while they function as intended, still don’t have the finished visuals, textures etc. We wanted to test this content with our players sooner than later to see if we’ve hit the mark so we decided to release this to testing now. Rest assured, missing textures will be added very soon. 

At this stage, we're mostly interested in your feedback about the changes to combat and all the new content additions, (listed below) and less interested in bug reports. Gameplay feedback is the priority right now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/9f4a812afe56034b7d050b1f445b19befd204b96.gif[/img]
[i]Backpack tiers and armor can now be discovered and unlocked in the new locations.[/i]

[h2]NEW UPDATE RELEASE WINDOW[/h2]

With all these additions, changes, and additional time for community feedback, we of course needed some extra development time. We opted to give the part of our team working on this the whole of August to make these improvements. 

Therefore as it stands, this update will launch into the main game in early September. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/41ca68e86c40cb6467d3fc001898913cb610ee39.gif[/img]
[i]Use Charged Bolts to clear pathways blocked by Growth Gates[/i]

[h2]SEND FEEDBACK AND STAND A CHANCE TO WIN 1 OF 10 STEAM GIFT CARDS WORTH 25 USD[/h2]

We know that taking time out to provide in-depth feedback is time-consuming, especially for content we've had available for some time now. 

So as a thank you to those who are helping us make the game better for everyone, we have put together a raffle where 10 beta testers who fill out the feedback form for the latest beta update will be sent a digital Steam gift card equivalent to 25 USD

[h2]REQUIREMENTS:[/h2]

Please play the latest beta update and when once you have experienced the bulk of it fill out this feedback form

[h3][b]➡️[url=https://forms.gle/PW9kYc7MjGdVktBx9]https://forms.gle/PW9kYc7MjGdVktBx9[/url]⬅️[/b][/h3]

[h2]HOW ARE WINNERS SELECTED?[/h2]

We will select 10 survey participants at random and will assess their feedback to see if feels legit and was filled in with actual intent and thought. So please don't just give everything a 10/10 as this will indicate to us this wasn't filled out with thought or intention to help. 

The 10 winners will then be contacted by us via Steam where they will need to accept a friend request from one of our dev accounts. 

[h2]STEAM PROFILE REQUIREMENTS EXPLAINED:[/h2]

In the survey you see we are asking you to provide your Steam username and set your  Steam profile to public. We are doing to so that we can:

1. Be sure you own Forever Skies
2. Can see the number of hours you've played in total
3. Allow us to send you your Steam Gift card

We are doing this to avoid rewarding people who simply submit answers to try win the gift cards and also to ensure we can get you your gift card if you are selected.

Details on how to change your profile privacy settings are here: 
https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/588C-C67D-0251-C276 

If you are not open to changing your profile to public for the duration of this raffle, we totally understand and you are of course still welcome to provide feedback on the beta. However, if your name is picked in the raffle we will need to pick someone else in your place if we can't find and view your Steam profile. 

----------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Combat Update (EA.1.6.0) NOW LIVE ON BETA
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings scientists…[/h3]

As per the title, the Combat Update is now live on our beta branch and can be played RIGHT NOW!

EA.1.6.0 features two new location variants, combat mechanics, new resources, story route changes, performance improvements, bug fixes, and a few QoL improvements, including the highest-voted request on Feature Upvote regarding moving storage boxes! 

More cool items will be added when the Combat Update goes live on the main branch, but for now let's get stuck into what you can expect from the update in beta.

[h2] 🔽Combat Feedback Survey🔽[/h2]

[h3][url=https://forms.gle/mTj9K4Hm8wEnLN6G6]https://forms.gle/mTj9K4Hm8wEnLN6G6 [/url][/h3]

Our team put a lot of work into the combat aspect of this update, so we're asking our avid beta testers to [b]please fill our survey after playing[/b]. 

This way we can dig deeper into your feedback and thoughts on how the game is shaping up.

[b][h2]Introducing Combat & Changes To Story[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/35b672eb8cc7904e82b6da39206c207008de3aa1.gif[/img]

As always, we recommend starting a new game with this latest update, as EA.1.6.0 makes significant changes to the “golden path” in the game, which becomes apparent towards the end of your first visit to the Underdust.

Previously players had to find ingredients such as the Mantis Glands, Dust Daisies or Patats, and a Medical Reagent to make an Immunity Booster to enter 3 different Infected Garden locations to acquire the research on the cure, this is no longer the case with the EA.1.6.0 update…

After failing to enter the Infected Garden, players are now tasked with finding ingredients for the Immunity Booster at two different locations nearby. Players also now only need to visit the one Infected Garden, instead of three.

The two new locations are Underdust variants but with a slight difference. There are no surface lifts in sight here. Instead, you will be descending on foot! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/18186ff30c27f9463af159a538c3ee339eb886b3.gif[/img]

The Crossbow has received an overhaul with new sound effects and a reload animation. As well as the standard Crossbow Bolts, players will also be able to get their hands on Poison Bolts, Explosive Bolts, and Throwable Mines, giving them quite a few options when facing hostiles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/0f7bcd8202c29f96926681d3efd8d50e79f21b5a.gif[/img]

But we also understand that not every player wants to engage in lethal combat, as such there are a few passive ways to deal with threats, players will also be able to craft Chirping Decoys and Stunning Traps to overcome enemies non-lethally.

If players choose not to start a new game to experience  the story changes, and have completed all current objectives, then a unique quest will be available where you can experience some of the new content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ebc39e690ea38c65b232711c0de2e29d826a1afc.gif[/img]

The challenge level in these locations is based on your difficulty settings, but will also get harder as you progress the story. So be sure to craft plenty of Oxygen Boosters, Endurance Boosters and Blood Coagulator Boosters if you plan to head to other “Combat Arena’s”, they’re sure to come in handy. 

Finally, combat has been added to the Underdust - Suburbs location as we originally promised when we released the Gardening Update back in Spring.

[b][h2]Moving Filled Storage Boxes & More[/h2][/b]

At the time of writing, the suggestion to move Storage Boxes is sat at the top of the pile of your feature requests with 500 upvotes on our [url=https://forever-skies.featureupvote.com/?order=trending&filter=all&tag=]Feature Upvote Site.[/url]
We are excited to announce that this QoL feature is available with EA.1.6.0! Players can now move Storage Boxes with contents and move them wherever they like onboard their Airship, making customization easier than ever. Just hold down Q on the box you want to move and a “ghost” of the storage box will be created in your hands. Simply place it in your chosen spot and the box and its contents will be instantly transported! This will also work with Freezers and Cookers containing food and Engines containing fuel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/f891c35cee612d4855012e4f30151713c99de50f.gif[/img]

We have worked on overall performance in the game as many had reported a significant drop in frames while playing. Please let us know how the game is running for you now!

We’ve also added a Quick Select Wheel menu to make your life a little easier (very handy when fending off a deadly Mantis), eating and drinking animations and Airship Builder crafting from storage QoL among other additions. And you can expect even more items when we come out of beta!

[h2]IMPORTANT REMINDER[/h2]

If the game is played from an older save (from the ending of the 1st Underdust questline up to creating the Evolved Flora Hologram), some issues might appear in the progression. We recommend starting a new save or playing on a save in which the main questline has already been completed to avoid these problems.

We recommend starting a new save or playing on a save in which the main questline has already been completed to avoid these problems.

[/list]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3]How To Access the Test Branch[/h3]

[list]
[*] Open the Steam application on your PC and locate Forever Skies in your games library
[*] Right click - PROPERTIES- BETAS
[*] Put in the password: BlimpWorkshop
[*] From the dropdown menu select the beta branch tilted: beta_flight
[*] Press the blue “Opt into beta_flight…” button
[*] In your Games Library click on Forever Skies [beta_flight]
[*] Install the Test Branch
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/61c2d01e45be73613aaa00be562f736b47406c25.png[/img]

[h3]How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch[/h3]

[list]
[*] Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:
[*] Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[*] C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\
[*] Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
[*] Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[*] C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\
[*] Paste your copied save file into this location
[*] As a precaution make a 2nd copy of your save file and paste it somewhere on your desktop or in a safe folder. This way you can ensure you have a clean, backup save just in case.
[/list]

After you have done the above, you can start the Forever Skies Test Branch from Steam and your save will be present when you select “CONTINUE”

[h3]Existing Saves Won’t be Affected but use an Imported Save To Play the Test Branch[/h3]

Your existing saves, progress, and any custom settings you’ve set in from the main game won’t be carried over to the Test Branch. Your pc will see this as if you are installing and playing the game for the first time ever. Likewise, by playing on the Test Branch, your main saves should not be affected at all.

This also means any progress on the test branch will not be carried over to the main game once the update is live. The test branch is designed to allow you to explore and test new features without impacting your current progress.

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. Instructions on how to do it can be found below.

[h3]Where to Submit Bugs[/h3]

All bugs or issues that you encounter while playing should be submitted via the FEEDBACK TOOL that you can find in-game when pausing the game. Subsequently, you can find the tool under this link too:

https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests

You can also submit bugs and keep up to date on features via our Feature Upvote site -
https://forever-skies.featureupvote.com/

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

That's all for now. And a reminder to please fill in the survey once you've played! 

[h2]🔽CombatT Feedback Survey🔽[/h2]
[h3][url=https://forms.gle/mTj9K4Hm8wEnLN6G6]https://forms.gle/mTj9K4Hm8wEnLN6G6[/url][/h3]

This will also be pinned in our discussion board for you to fill in later.

Speak soon!

[i]- Team Far From Home[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/e826df6a263b322eb6f05d481aad7da81eaafe3b.png[/img]

Also, if you were one of our Kickstarter backers, your in-game rewards are ready and have been added alongside this patch. Check your associated email for more details!

notes.title: Our Next Patch Highlights + First Dwarf Bundle
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings scientists![/h3]

We wanted to give you a heads-up on what is being added in our next patch and let you know that EA.1.5.3 is now live on the beta branch!

[b][h2]First Dwarf x Forever Skies Bundle is Available[/h2][/b]

First off though, we've partnered on a bundle with our fellow Polish devs Stardrifters in support of their new game [b]First Dwarf.[/b]

First Dwarf is an action RPG with mechs, colony survival, crafting, base building, and tower defense mechanics all blended into one amazing mix. Explore a fantasy open world, sprawling on islands floating in the sky. You can play it solo or get a buddy to join through coop assist mode.

They are launching with a 15% discount and if you already own Forever Skies you can grab an extra 10% using our bundle.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42411/First_Dwarf_x_Forever_Skies/

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][h2]Our Next Patch[/h2][/b]

ICYMI, a few days ago we uploaded our June devlog, where we revealed some of the exciting new features coming to EA.1.5.3!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ae784e4e91dde362b24bd45df86d010bac2abeb5.png[/img]

[b][h2]Its Not Just a Bug It's Also a Feature[/h2][/b]

The next content patch puts the spotlight on our friendly insect pet, making it not just adorable, but incredibly practical too!

“Pet the bug” is a feature we have planned and made public since we released our first roadmap in June 2023, but we didn’t want to just stop there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/9a0cb3b5785eb601f01d244387ca0995bcba4624.gif[/img]

Players will be able to customize their pet with a fancy hat, a backpack and a harness in a few different colours. We plan on adding more customization options as development progresses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ebf455b896d833779894f07c030bb62862deb6e0.gif[/img]

The hat and harness options are purely cosmetic. They add to the bugs wholesome aesthetic but thats all. However, we hope the backpack will be a game changer for players. Give your pet this attachment from the customization menu and have it join you on your adventures away from the airship. 

Your pockets getting full while you explore? Off-load some of those resources into your pet’s backpack. The total number of slots available is not final and will be balanced throughout the beta phase. Eventually, we would love to have a range of backpack upgrades with increasing slots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/67e5665100775dd027ca63e8d25f200d6fafdda7.gif[/img]

[b][h2]New Airship Decor[/h2][/b]

EA.1.5.3 isn’t just about your pet, as we have also added some new Airship decorations and a new room module.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/934484d8b4944aeeb9370eb2334c8b41b801a22e.gif[/img]

We have added a new Stairs Room Module, a Kingsize Bed that recovers your energy levels quicker and more!

[b]EA.1.5.3 will also include Japanese and Korean localization![/b]

[b]ALL of this content is available RIGHT NOW on our beta branch[/b]. Instructions on how to join can be found at the bottom of this blog. We will be adding more content throughout the beta, such as interior lighting decor range, Kickstarter rewards if you were one of our backers and more!

------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]BETA PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[h3]NEW CONTENT:[/h3]

[b]Pet:[/b]
[list]
[*] Friendly Insect “Pet” interaction added
[*] Friendly Insect companion can follow the player during exploration
[*] Friendly Insect companion, while equipped with backpack, unlocks additional inventory slots

[/list]

[*] Basic set of pet’s equipment is unlocked when the Friendly Insect is first placed on the Soft Cushion
[*] Crafting recipes available through a new set of Data Cards (green)
[*] Three colored sets of the Pet’s outfits (cap, shoes and backpack)
[/list]
[b]Tools & Devices:[/b]
[list]
[*] Amber King Size Bed - enhances the sleeping process
[*] Crystal Lamp (left and right)
[*] Sprinkler Lamp
[/list]
[b]Airship:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stair Room
[/list]
[b]Resources:[/b]
[list]
[*] Neon plant
[/list]
[b]Localization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[/list]
[h3]CHANGED:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Soft Cushion trigger for opening pet’s equipment screen
[/list]
[h3]FIXED:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pig Smile Seeds icon fixed so it can match all the other small plant seeds
[*] Proper Advanced Pass Component icon implemented
[/list]
[h3]KNOWN ISSUES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Friendly Insect can follow the player only while the airship is docked (lands on a location’s platform). This means the pet won’t follow you while the Airship is in the air and when visiting locations accessed via the Docking Plank. We are currently working on this and will implement the fix soon.
[*] Using Quick Move (Shift+Click), the player can move items from their inventory to the Friendly Insect’s inventory even if a pet’s backpack wasn’t crafted yet. These items can be accessed after the pet’s backpack is equipped.
[*] There is currently no boiled version of the Neon Plant. 
[*] Localization for non-English languages is still work in progress and will be updated before this update goes live on main (leaves beta)
[*] Textures are currently missing from Stairs Room module, the pets yellow outfit and Crystal Lamp
[*] Icons for the new lamps, Neon Plant, and the Stair Room missing
[/list]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b][h2]How To Access the Test Branch[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Open the Steam application on your PC and locate Forever Skies in your games library
[*] Right click - PROPERTIES- BETAS
[*] Put in the password: BlimpWorkshop
[*] From the dropdown menu select the beta branch tilted: beta_flight
[*] Press the blue “Opt into beta_flight…” button
[*] In your Games Library click on Forever Skies [beta_flight]
[*] Install the Test Branch
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/61c2d01e45be73613aaa00be562f736b47406c25.png[/img]

[b][h2]How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch[/h2][/b]

Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:
[list]
[*] Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[*] C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\
[*] Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
[*] Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[*] C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\
[*] Paste your copied save file into this location
[*] As a precaution make a 2nd copy of your save file and paste it somewhere on your desktop or in a safe folder. This way you can ensure you have a clean, backup save just in case.
[/list]

After you have done the above, you can start the Forever Skies Test Branch from Steam and your save will be present when you select “CONTINUE”

[h3]Existing Saves Won’t be Affected but use an Imported Save To Play the Test Branch[/h3]

Your existing saves, progress, and any custom settings you’ve set in from the main game won’t be carried over to the Test Branch. Your pc will see this as if you are installing and playing the game for the first time ever. Likewise, by playing on the Test Branch, your main saves should not be affected at all.

This also means any progress on the test branch will not be carried over to the main game once the update is live. The test branch is designed to allow you to explore and test new features without impacting your current progress.

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. Instructions on how to do it can be found below.

[h3]Where to Submit Bugs[/h3]

All bugs or issues that you encounter while playing should be submitted via the FEEDBACK TOOL that you can find in-game when pausing the game. Subsequently, you can find the tool under this link too:

https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests
You can also submit bugs and keep up to date on features via our Feature Upvote site - https://forever-skies.featureupvote.com/

Thats all for now, speak soon!

notes.title: “Crafting & Fuelling” Patch Now Live + New Bundle Offer!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings scientists![/h3]

Patch EA.1.5.2 is now live and includes a bunch of new features and we just launched a bundle with fellow mobile base survivalists Volcanoids!

[b][h2]Volcanoids x Forever Skies Bundle is Available [/h2][/b]
First off, we've partnered on a bundle with our good friends behind Volcanoids. Volcanoids is a fantastic base-building, open-world survival shooter that replaces your typical base with a mobile, giant drill. 

And you know we're all fans of mobile bases here! Alone or with friends, explore an island plagued by eruptions, upgrade your drill, and fight robots to uncover what's been hiding beneath the surface.

If you already own Forever Skies you can grab an extra 15% using our bundle. Click below.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41771/Volcanoids_x_Forever_Skies

[b][h2]What's Been Added in the New Update?[/h2][/b]
Alright, so let's get into what’s new! Here is a quick overview with more details for each further down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/563a9255f51e5f8174428609f7463282d9fabf74.png[/img]

[b][h2]Craft From Storage[/h2][/b]
We heard your feedback! With EA.1.5.2, players can now craft items directly from all storage boxes on your Airship. This QOL improvement will save players a lot of time finding where they placed that last Polymer piece!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/2a317f316cfb456612931e88bf7489fe9be2dabf.png[/img]

We have also updated the UI to show players what and how many resources they have in their inventory & storage total when crafting.

This option can be turned off in the settings for those who prefer a more traditional survival game experience

[b][h2]Fuel Tank[/h2][/b]
The tank holds up to 400 units of fuel at a time and can be placed anywhere on your airship, meaning you no longer have to run to each individual Upgraded Engine to refuel it, all fuel types can be placed inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/a4da611de59c912d9d5fc20312dd284d030f4932.png[/img]

This new Airship item can be found at the Overgrown Lift location and becomes craftable once you have the Upgrade Station (for now). With one Fuel Tank, players can connect pipes from the tank to two Upgraded Engines using the same pipe system as airship gardening.

We have also introduced the Cross-Pipe which gives you the ability to overlap pipes and provides more freedom when placing them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/625693f83144fd305ed3f19454d03eae4b7ae395.png[/img]

We need to hear your thoughts after trying this new system! Does it help? Does it make refuelling your Airship easier? What improvements would you like to see? Let us know…

[b][h2]Moth Aquarium[/h2][/b]
Introducing the Moth Aquarium! I guess it’s technically a Vivarium? But you get the point! With this new decoration, you can keep any moths you catch alive for decoration (or consumption, no judgement, a scientists gotta eat!)

We would love to do more with the Aquarium in the future, (breeding, anyone?) but for now this will look great in your on-board your airship!

Also, look how those little guys come alive when you turn on your Flashlight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/dd5f3d2bc364a91f39520d5b833d1a7321934310.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Bloom Exterior Modules & Decorative Wings[/h2][/b]
EA.1.5.2 adds to the Bloom range by including new Exterior Bloom Modules. Such as a new Catwalk style and a couple of new railing designs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/840fce3c7482833860252cdd38cc594bfbadd962.png[/img]

We have also added additional decorative wings. These can be placed anywhere on the outside of your airship providing there is space. 

They won’t help you survive the world or navigate the skies. You don’t exactly *need* them to complete your objectives either, but they will sure make your airship exterior look way cooler!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/7e62f60525081ee198711f8fcc128be60c0b5e0b.png[/img]

[b][h2]New Upgrade Station[/h2][/b]
The Upgrade Station gets…well…upgraded in EA.1.5.2, just like how the Ship Workstation did last month. This station which is used to upgrade your Airship and personal tech, now has a brand new model and animation.

It's a small change in the game, but we hope these small changes improve your overall experience when playing Forever Skies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/4455929038beeeb93c87f382b14fadc43eca0396.png[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][/b]

Here are the full patch notes for EA.1.5.2:

[b][h3]NEW CONTENT:[/h3][/b]

[b]Devices:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fuel Tank
[*] Aquarium for Moths
[*] Cross pipes 
[*] Airship:
[*] Bloom Catwalk
[*] Bloom High Railing (left and right)

notes.content:
[h3]Greetings scientists![/h3]

Patch EA.1.5.2 is now live on our beta test branch for all of our willing beta testers out there. Here is a breakdown of what you can expect…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/a1bfb52e3b0f29cf32a316a739f9ebe024944edf.png[/img]

[b][h2]Craft From Storage[/h2][/b]
We heard your feedback! With EA.1.5.2, players can now craft items directly from all storage boxes on your Airship. This QOL improvement will save players a lot of time finding where they placed that last Polymer piece!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/2a317f316cfb456612931e88bf7489fe9be2dabf.png[/img]

We have also updated the UI to show players what and how many resources they have in their inventory & storage total when crafting.

This option can be turned off in the settings for those who prefer a more traditional survival experience.

[b][h2]Fuel Tank[/h2][/b]
The tank holds up to 400 units of fuel at a time and can be placed anywhere on your airship, meaning you no longer have to run to each individual Upgraded Engine to refuel it, all fuel types can be placed inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/4a4a3a1028e478acc8c47b02e761e769560e5bce.png[/img]

This new Airship item can be found at the Overgrown Lift location and becomes craftable once you have the Upgrade Station (for now). With one Fuel Tank, players can connect pipes from the tank to two Upgraded Engines using the same pipe system as airship gardening.

We have also introduced the Cross-Pipe which gives you the ability to overlap pipes and provides more freedom when placing them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/625693f83144fd305ed3f19454d03eae4b7ae395.png[/img]

We need to hear your thoughts after trying this new system! Does it help? Does it make refuelling your Airship easier? What improvements would you like to see? Let us know…

[b][h2]Moth Aquarium[/h2][/b]
Introducing the Moth Aquarium! I guess it’s technically a Vivarium? But you get the point! With this new food storage/decoration, you can keep any moths you catch alive for decoration (or consumption, no judgement, a scientists gotta eat!)

We would love to do more with the Aquarium in the future, (breeding, anyone?) but for now this will look great in your on-board kitchens!

Also, look how those little guys come alive when you turn on your Flashlight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/cdb3483b161b7dee5e7eff15c2d8546b456b1d86.gif[/img]
[i]Model shown is WIP[/i]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Patch Notes

Here are the full patch notes for EA.1.5.2:

[h2]NEW CONTENT:[/h2]

[b]Devices:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fuel Tank
[*] Aquarium for Moths
[*] Cross pipes 
[*] Airship:
[*] Bloom Catwalk
[*] Bloom High Railing (left and right)
[*] Bloom Railing
[*] Bloom Short Railing
[/list]

[list]
[*] Dragonfly Wing (left and right)
[*] Entwined wing (left and right)
[*] Fish Bones wing (left and right)
[*] Root wing (left and right)
[/list]

[b]Player:[/b]
[list]
[*] Crafting directly from storage 
[*] Craft From Storage - toggle Gameplay options
[/list]

[h2]CHANGED:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fuel inlet socket on Upgraded Engines support leg
[*] New model for Upgrade Station,  animations and VFXs
[*] Fabricator UI change to show inventory and storage crafting. Switched on or off accordingly
[/list]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] When the player connects water to the engine, it doesn't give feedback about "No Fuel", but the player is unable to fly.
[*] Fuel tank can be connected to water tank, then when you add water, water will disappear 
[*] Fuel tank can be connected to sprinklers and will water the pots
[*] Missing scanning material on Wrecked Fuel Tank
[*] Fuel Tank is researchable for Fabricator, but it is craftable in the Upgrade Station
[*] Upgraded Engine fuel inlet port positioning
[*] Weight of Bloom exterior modules to be adjusted
[*] Missing localization 
[/list]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h2]How To Access the Test Branch[/h2]

[list]
[*] Open the Steam application on your PC and locate Forever Skies in your games library
[*] Right click - PROPERTIES- BETAS
[*] Put in the password: BlimpWorkshop
[*] From the dropdown menu select the beta branch tilted: beta_flight
[*] Press the blue “Opt into beta_flight…” button
[*] In your Games Library click on Forever Skies [beta_flight]
[*] Install the Test Branch
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/61c2d01e45be73613aaa00be562f736b47406c25.png[/img]

[h2]How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch[/h2]

Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:
[list]
[*] Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[*] C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\
[*] Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
[*] Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[*] C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\
[*] Paste your copied save file into this location
[*] As a precaution make a 2nd copy of your save file and paste it somewhere on your desktop or in a safe folder. This way you can ensure you have a clean, backup save just in case.
[/list]

After you have done the above, you can start the Forever Skies Test Branch from Steam and your save will be present when you select “CONTINUE”

[h2]Existing Saves Won’t be Affected but use an Imported Save To Play the Test Branch[/h2]

Your existing saves, progress, and any custom settings you’ve set in from the main game won’t be carried over to the Test Branch. Your pc will see this as if you are installing and playing the game for the first time ever. Likewise, by playing on the Test Branch, your main saves should not be affected at all.

This also means any progress on the test branch will not be carried over to the main game once the update is live. The test branch is designed to allow you to explore and test new features without impacting your current progress.

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. Instructions on how to do it can be found below.

[h2]Where to Submit Bugs[/h2]

All bugs or issues that you encounter while playing should be submitted via the FEEDBACK TOOL that you can find in-game when pausing the game. Subsequently, you can find the tool under this link too:

https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests

You can also submit bugs and keep up to date on features via our Feature Upvote site - https://forever-skies.featureupvote.com/

Thats all for now, speak soon!

notes.title: 2024 Roadmap & FFH Celebrates 4th Birthday
notes.content:
[h3]Hello scientists![/h3]

We’re excited to share our roadmap for the rest of 2024 with you, now that the Airship Gardening update has been released and its follow-up patch, EA.1.5.1, here are the main updates for the rest of the year and some smaller content patches due in the next few months.

[h2][b]ROADMAP[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/a733d541723f64076a7da428b8d63684987d0d1c.png[/img]

We have several large updates left to release this year. The Combat Update, the highly anticipated Co-op Update and the full release will also add additional content like the final story chapter and more. These updates will contain many additional features and improvements, just like the larger updates that have already been released. Exactly what features you can expect from each will be revealed at a later date.

Patch EA.1.5.1 was released a few days ago and now we look to the rest of the year. We’re committed to releasing one content update/patch every month until full release. The graphic above announces our next two planned content patches, currently named Fuelling & Storage Crafting (EA.1.5.2) and Friendly Insect (EA 1.5.3). There will be additional patches announced in the year, and these will be determined based on your feedback and suggestions.

As always, please note that the roadmap is subject to change and we will notify you if that should occur.

[h2][b]Far From Home 4th Birthday[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/02534ad8b1f32e620e698ac259de2e6f618c9876.png[/img]

It’s a cliche to say, but the last 4 years have truly been a rollercoaster for us in the studio, and the last 12 months have been especially eventful.


When we launched Far From Home, we had 3 main goals:
[olist]
[*] To create a great work environment which will allow people to grow, be ambitious, and have a real impact on the projects and the studio itself.
[*] To serve players. Our role is to listen, watch, analyze and bring the best possible experience for the gaming community. 
[*] To start a discussion about the future of the Earth and humankind. We believe that games can be a tool for enacting change in the world and with this in mind, we want to blend important topics with the joy of gaming.
[/olist]
We have continued to work towards these goals with what we have achieved in the last 12 months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/e16f0c8c76a55cabc387e7e932dc19855df0116b.png[/img]

Of course, none of this would have been possible without you guys. So as always, we want to thank you for engaging with us, giving feedback and showing passion for Forever Skies and what we’re trying to achieve as a studio.

What we can promise is that we will continue to listen to your voice and work on making Forever Skies great! Cheers to you, our fantastic community. In addition, we wanted to reemphasize that Far From Home remains independent and is the sole publisher of Forever Skies and future titles!


That's all for now. Got any questions? Drop them in the comments.

[b]Team Far From Home[/b]

notes.title: Introducing Our Feature Upvotes Board!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings scientists!
[/h3]
Introducing the Forever Skies Feature Upvotes board! A great platform for players to report bugs, request features and generally send us your feedback!

We've been listening closely to your feedback and ideas. We understand that you, our amazing community, are bursting with useful feedback and awesome ideas for what Forever Skies can become. Therefore we have decided to create a Feature Upvotes page to empower you to make Forever Skies as awesome as it can be. 

[h2][b]How does it work?[/b][/h2]

[b]Visit the Feature Upvotes Page[/b] 

Head to the website - [url=https://forever-skies.featureupvote.com]https://forever-skies.featureupvote.com[/url], this link will also be pinned in Discussions within the Community Hub, on our Discord and in other convenient places. 

For now, The SEND FEEDBACK option in the pause menu will still take you to the original form, but this will be changed as soon as possible. We understand how vital it is for players to access this new feature via the game itself, and so we will replace this link soon. But for now, you can report bugs with either the original form or Feature Upvote.

When you access the board, this is what you will see. Be sure to read and follow the simple site rules we have laid out. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/9eff3b9a83f42017f2fc81c25a33e86d1d5eaf74.png[/img]

[b]Cast Your Votes[/b]

Before sending your idea, peruse the submitted ideas and cast your votes for the features you'd love to see in Forever Skies. Somebody else might have already suggested the same thing and we want to avoid repeating cards, so upvote their card instead.

[b]Submit Your Ideas[/b] 

Have a cool concept, an ingenious gameplay mechanic, or an immersive storyline idea? Share it with us and the community! Describe your idea, provide details, and attach any supporting screens or tags to make your case. Report bugs in the same way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/906d888f131b58ce823a95052d4de23c2aefa292.png[/img]

[b]Track Progress[/b]

Keep tabs on the most popular feature requests, see which ones are in development, and stay updated on their progress through the developer status’ and comments

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/83489326ae10aa6997cc848d33d8b86430fdb1c0.png[/img]

[b]Get Involved [/b]

Engage in discussions with the Forever Skies community, developers, and moderators. Collaborate to refine ideas and make them even more incredible.

By introducing the Feature Upvotes Page, we aim to foster a sense of community and collaboration in a better way than before. Your input is invaluable to us, and this platform ensures that not only can you see what you and other players want out of Forever Skies, it also gives you a visual on the popularity of your ideas and real dev input regarding the likeliness of your ideas making it into the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/f73a27905327474ff0a3210a94f3bbc00d5faaad.png[/img]

[h3][b]**DISCLAIMER**[/b][/h3] - It’s important to note, that this board's primary purpose is to give our devs a perfect understanding of what features our community want most and what the biggest issues are in the current build, it helps us prioritise our workload. However, if a card becomes popular and gets heavily upvoted,[b] this does not guarantee that the feature will be implemented into the game[/b]. There are internal factors that must also be considered still such as the cost of time and funds to implement these ideas. Keep an eye on the status of cards and comments of the devs so you get the transparency you deserve from us. 

We hope you enjoy using our Feature Upvote board! 
Team Far From Home

notes.title: We’ve partnered with Krafton Inc. joining the ranks of Subnautica and PUBG
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Scientists![/h3]

We’ve got some big news about our studio floating around today and we wanted to take a moment here to fully explain what this means for us, our game, and for you as players.

Today we announced that Krafton Inc. will acquire a minority stake in our studio. So let's go through what this means exactly.

[h2]Why We’ve Partnered With Krafton and the likes of Subnautica and PUBG: Battlegrounds?
[/h2]

Firstly, Krafton Inc has an undisputed track record having invested in the likes of one of the most acclaimed survival games Subnautica, and one of the biggest coop hits, PUBG: Battlegrounds to name a few. This partnership potentially gives us unprecedented access to knowledge and expertise from studios we’ve admired for a long time. Rest assured, we’re not going to turn Forever Skies into a battle royal game, nor are we going clone Subnautica. But simply being able to talk to the people behind these monumental games to get insight and advice is fantastic for us.

This may also open the door for us to do possible cross-overs and partnerships with these titles and any others that Krafton works with. Nothing has been done in this direction right now, so we aren’t making any promises or subtle teases here. We’re simply saying this is something we can look into now, which is equally great for us.

[h2]Our Future is Firmly in our Hands[/h2]

The partnership with Krafton essentially secures our studio’s long-term future. In a time where every month we are all seeing studios both large and small mass laying off employees, canceling games, and overall scrambling to survive, it is a massive relief that this won’t be an issue for us.

While the sales of Forever Skies so far have been strong enough to keep the studio going, this partnership ensures a safety net that lets us fully focus on making Forever Skies the best it can be while also knowing we have the room to think about our next title in the years to come.

[i]“Our funding for the completion of Forever Skies is secured, but eventually, we will need to
start looking ahead at what comes next for our team. The capital raised through Krafton will
make it significantly easier for us to plan out and build our next title to be something bigger
and even more ambitious.”[/i] - Andrzej Blumenfeld, CEO, Far From Home

[h2]Forever Skies Development Remains Unchanged[/h2]

Rest assured that any work on our next game will only happen after the completion of Forever Skies development while also making sure we have ample room to do meaningful post-full-launch support. Tomorrow we will be publishing our road map for the remainder of 2024 so you can see what we have planned next. 

[h2]Far From Home Remains Independent[/h2]

The partnership with Krafton Inc. is shaped in such a way that Far From Home remains fully independent and in full creative control of Forever Skies and future titles. Krafton Inc is a minority shareholder so our team has the final say on key decisions based on the direction of the studio and our titles. 

[h2]Thank You For Getting Us Here[/h2]

This is a monumental moment for our studio to say the least. We have secured our long future while still retaining full control of everything we decide to do. Krafton’s belief in our vision and desire to support our growth is a massive boost to us but we also know that had it not been for you, our players, who gave Forever Skies a chance since we launched in Early Access, none of this could have happened. So a big thank you to all of you for helping us and Forever Skies reach such new heights.

We hope this post and our desire to be upfront clears up any concerns and if you have further questions, do leave them in the comments. 

- The Far From Home Team

notes.title: Patch EA.1.5.1 "Gardening Plus" Now Live!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings scientists,[/h3]

Patch EA.1.5.1 (Build #28037) has been beta-tested for nearly two weeks, and is now live on our main branch!

This patch is made up of content that wasn’t quite ready in time for the Airship Gardening update (EA.1.5.0) at the end of March. With so much content going into the last update, some assets had to be temporarily cut due to time constraints. But that's not the case anymore, here they are!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/e094b33fd268217c3cff5f89920ba6bf5c13d510.png[/img]

[h2][b]Seven New Cockpit Styles Added[/b][/h2]

A lot of players tell us that they love customizing their Airship and want more modules to play around and experiment with.

You also keep telling us you want stairs…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/413fc8bb49e5c5d6e5b910f74b3a5d7f6bf2e9eb.gif[/img]

The new Bloom Cockpit Range is definitely worth checking out with their unique 2-floor design, complete with stairs. They’re available in 1-wide, 2-wide and 3-wide variants. They don’t even need to be used as a cockpit, as they also make a nice open and spacious room for your airship base. Instead, why not choose from some of the other new cockpit modules?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/913a545b504fb6ea4403929701496e2110232fd8.gif[/img]

You asked for it, we heard you…introducing the Inverted cockpit range! For those of you who prefer a more traditional airship cockpit design, an inverted variant can now be unlocked in the game. As before, they are available in 1, 2 and 3-wide (we have also added a 3-wide normal cockpit too)

Now there are even more options to make your Airship base uniquelly yours. We won’t be stopping here either, as more modules are currently in development.

[h2][b]Water Pipe Sockets[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ef6b2d77a05129cf28500c566f230a6e58dcaca5.png[/img]

Now players can pass water through walls using Pipe Sockets. These now automatically unlock when players scan the Water Pipes at the Infected Garden location. Water Generators can now only be placed outside (as intended) and using the new Sockets, water can travel from the Generator outside, into your Airship Garden room on the inside. It also means your Airship can have more than one garden room, without having to create two separate Gardening systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/de45f2e03016117e24adac32be8404eccf6b9cd0.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Localization: Portuguese - Brazil[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/c66b1d87ebc1844a15a0e8e0df31934ac23892cf.png[/img]

Portuguese - Brazil is the latest language to be added. [b]We will not stop here[/b], there are still languages we plan to localize Forever Skies into. Please let us know which ones you would like to see.

[h2][b]Visual Improvements[/b][/h2]

We continue to make small improvements to the visuals and audio of the game which we hope will lead to a better experience overall for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/d6d2ca8a5fe05675b1ae549a82d1442806b8b46f.gif[/img]

We have added an animation for when players consume a Booster in-game. It’s only a small thing, but we hope it adds to the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/c6b30e8a8218fff070abdd836b4badf6a1038dcd.png[/img]

Another visual improvement we made was to the model and animation of the Ship Workstation. The old model has always been a placeholder in our minds, we believe the updated model is to the correct standard now. What do you think about these changes?

[h2][b]SFX Improvements[/b][/h2]

We have made some audio improvements with EA.1.5.1 too. Probably the most noticeable improvement are [b]BREATHING NOISES![/b]

Yes, our scientist now sounds a lot less…robotic…when they are out of breath, which is a much-needed change. Other audio additions with this patch include SFX for the Distiller, ambient sounds in the Underdust - Suburbs, sounds added to the “Discovering Noah cutscene” and more. 

Here are the full patch notes for EA.1.5.1

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3]NEW CONTENT:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Pipe Sockets study recipe added after scanning Pipes (should be present in Research Station if Pipes were scanned already)
[/list]
[b]Airship:[/b]

[/list]
[b]KNOWN ISSUES: [/b]
[list]
[*] Playing hand animation while interacting with Rudder or Deck Extractor while having a tool equipped
[*] Player model detaching from the camera while using Deck Extractor, sometimes leading to the player falling off their Airship AKA death.
[*] If you aim the crossbow and crouch, your character’s walk and run speed will be intensely slowed down
[*] Mydriasis Inhibitor missing on Infected Garden locations, despite the item being shown in the Studies menu
[*] Fertilizer in the Small Pot never ends, and the icon shows 6/5 units inside the bottle
[*] Shift+Clicking on an item in a toolbar while being in a Fabricator/Upgrade Station/Ship Workstation/Distiller menu will result in losing the item
[*] Cooking Station’s water capacity exceeds the limit of 20
[*] Pipes are not showing the connection to the device and the water flow (despite it being already established and working) after saving and loading the game
[*] Big Gardening Pot doesn’t have a “Remove Plant” function
[/list]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thats all for now, we will have more news to share with you next week!
Team Far From Home

[h2]How To Access the Test Branch[/h2]
[list]
[*] Open the Steam application on your PC and locate Forever Skies in your games library
[*] Right click - PROPERTIES- BETAS
[*] Put in the password: BlimpWorkshop
[*] From the dropdown menu select the beta branch tilted: beta_flight
[*] Press the blue “Opt into beta_flight…” button
[*] In your Games Library click on Forever Skies [beta_flight]
[*] Install the Test Branch
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/61c2d01e45be73613aaa00be562f736b47406c25.png[/img]

[h2]How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch[/h2]

Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:
[list]
[*] Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[*] C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\
[*] Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
[*] Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[*] C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\
[*] Paste your copied save file into this location
[*] As a precaution make a 2nd copy of your save file and paste it somewhere on your desktop or in a safe folder. This way you can ensure you have a clean, backup save just in case.
[/list]
After you have done the above, you can start the Forever Skies Test Branch from Steam and your save will be present when you select “CONTINUE”

[h2]Existing Saves Won’t be Affected but use an Imported Save To Play the Test Branch[/h2]

Your existing saves, progress, and any custom settings you’ve set in from the main game won’t be carried over to the Test Branch. Your pc will see this as if you are installing and playing the game for the first time ever. Likewise, by playing on the Test Branch, your main saves should not be affected at all.

This also means any progress on the test branch will not be carried over to the main game once the update is live. The test branch is designed to allow you to explore and test new features without impacting your current progress.

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. Instructions on how to do it can be found below.

[h2]Where to Submit Bugs[/h2]

All bugs or issues that you encounter while playing should be submitted via the FEEDBACK TOOL that you can find in-game when pausing the game. You can also access it [url=https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests]here.[/url]

Thats all for now, speak soon!

notes.title: Airship Gardening Update Is Live!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings scientists![/h3]

As per the title, our largest-ever update, “Airship Gardening” is now live for all. Below are some of the key new features and improvements you can expect from EA.1.5.0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ace0cdf9dad15a0e5481935ce3f72ad7bd96dc78.png[/img]

This is by far the largest update we’ve released since the start of Early Access. 

Our team have been working hard on this update since the launch of The Frozen Wishes Update back in December, and there is a lot to see!

[h3]Saves[/h3]

We would highly recommend players start a brand new game to fully experience every new change and addition included in the Airship Gardening update. Such as improved story, locations and world improvements. Your old saves will still work, just you will experience the flow of the new content a little differently. 

[b]Your rewards from the Frozen Wishes update are no longer tied to your save files[/b]. This means if you unlocked the rewards from the festive quest back in December, they will carry over and be unlockable in any new save you create.

Here is a breakdown of the main additions you can expect from this update and the full patch notes…

[h2][b]Airship Gardening Mechanics[/b][/h2]

Gardening will play an important role in the game loop, but also the story. If you wish to keep your gardening setup simple and just grow a few crops for food and for the story, you can totally do that. But if you want to go all out with these mechanics and make the most of this mechanic, it’s safe to say you should be able to create some really impressive floating greenhouses!

You will be able to add water tanks, a Distiller for different fertilizers, different size pots, a network of pipes, sprinklers and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/7b170a06f67e3cf3ef88ddbe42892b0dc6ad8ae4.gif[/img]

Different pieces of the new gardening tech can be found in several places across our procedurally generated world. Some of the more basic equipment like pots and water tanks are easier to find as they’re placed in more than one location. However, the more advanced technology like Distillers and Water Generators are a tad more rare. Be sure to check your Studies Menu!

In most cases, you will need to plant the seed for the item you want to grow. This process is relatively pain-free as all perishable items like food, medicine and plants now stack in your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/7cf969fda6877e0aed81a0d1ec434af73fbaeaba.gif[/img]

You can increase the speed at which a plant grows by adding a special fertilizer from the Distiller. This fertilizer is made from Rotten Food (yes, it now has a purpose, yay!) Plants that only grow in the Underdust like Breathnuts and more can also be grown, providing you craft the Dust Fertilizer and add it to the garden pot.

[h2][b]Story Chapter 2 - Hunt For The Cure[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/faba426a3f730c2134f2a234c171dba1db94eb19.png[/img]

[h3]CHAPTER 1 RECAP / SPOILERS AHEAD![/h3]

The first chapter of our story came to an end with the Viral Evolution update. We found what was left of Noah in the Underdust, followed by his research in the Infected Gardens. With that research we were able to craft a hologram which provided the coordinates to the location of the cure that we have been looking for - as was Noah and the previous expedition before us.

As we mentioned before, gardening will play a role in the next section of the story. In addition, we will also be taking our next trip back down to the surface of the planet.

[h2][b]New Underdust Section - Suburbs[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ba75f31cfc7e6317c2a6a6eecd381f83bb3008fc.gif[/img]

This update features a brand new Underdust map for players to explore, The Suburbs. Players will head here during this latest chapter in search of the elusive cure. This map is roughly 4-times larger than the first Underdust map in Chapter 1 and a lot more open. Thankfully, there are a few landmarks to help players get their bearings in this foggy biome AND a Large Oxygen Bottle to make exploration a lot easier.

We hope you have fun down there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/d788d20aafffde0d72b06341b73ba6a924abc874.gif[/img]

Down here you will find a lot of new useful items to collect and new blueprints to research and craft. Including new plant seeds, organic substances for special fertilizers, blueprints for Gardening technology and a new upgraded version of the knife, the Aircutter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/21f441a8baa84aa6c2de3321c94239baae33a5ad.png[/img]

[h3]A side note on combat…[/h3]

With a new exciting Underdust biome to explore, Im sure that many players were hoping to exchange blows with Mantis enemies and more with this update. However, we made the difficult decision to temporarily hold off on this feature, [b]but only for now[/b]…

While we have got combat working in the development stages, we weren’t 100% happy with it and so have decided to spend more time on this feature so it can be better. We keep a watchful eye on other survival games and so we know how passionate survival game players are about this being done right, which is why this decision was made. In addition, we don’t want combat to be isolated in just this one location, we want it to be bigger and better, so some of our team will be focusing on this after the launch of the Airship Gardening update.

[h2][b]Improved World & Story Progression[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/b12c726044790ac6ca3235e477eb3f4815f0f2b9.png[/img]

Not only have we added new story and content with this update, we have also gone back and made improvements to the world and story that already existed in Forever Skies. This was done to make gameplay more fun and make the story easier to understand. The following was done thanks to your incredible feedback:
[list]
[*] Many mission objectives re-written to give players a better and more immersive experience
[*] Mission Reports - summarizing main quest milestones for the player upon returning to the airship from main quest locations
[*] More lore scenes added 
[*] Story-related voice lines - from the players "suit AI" added
[*] New cutscenes
[*] Design, art and gameplay improvements to existing locations like Radio Towers, Overgrown Radio Towers, Gardens & Descent Lifts.
[*] City ruins improved visually
[/list]
Again, we highly recommend players start a fresh save to fully experience all of the above changes. However, if players wish to simply continue from the previous saves and continue the story from where it left off then this is also possible. Your rewards from the Frozen Wishes Update will no longer be affected!

[h2][b]New Airship Module Design - “Bloom Range” [/b][/h2]

Airship customization is important in Forever Skies. Because of this, we have added our first new Airship modules, the “Bloom Range”. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/6191a3e3dbdf5168ae2baa91d0354ab680bbe157.png[/img]

These modules can be found on our re-worked data card system - more details below in the full patch notes. We are only getting started with new modules. Coming soon we plan to add additional modules like new cockpits, balloons, exterior modules, stairs and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/e23ff2ad2f2054fce89af7fdfe93073e3b2af4e6.gif[/img]

Airship Gardening introduces a new cleaner HUD design to players. We decided to update our HUD for a few important reasons:
[list]
[*] With the changes made to Immunity a few months ago thanks to your feedback, the immunity Circle on the HUD became redundant as it was no longer a mechanic you would have to manage. Instead, immunity is now tied to the story and will change as a scripted event. Your current immunity status can now be found on the Inventory screen.
[*] Cleaner and easier to understand. Certain icons were not explained well in the old design, such as using boosters or diseases. The new HUD displays this in a much clearer manner
[*] Player parameters with distinguished Stamina/Energy and Radiation Zone alerts. 
[/list]
Please let us know your thoughts on the HUD changes. Do you prefer them? Is it an improvement? We’re listening!

[h3]A side note on The Flashlight…[/h3]

We made some changes to how players acquire the Flashlight in a recent update, EA.1.4.2, and again with this latest update, EA.1.5.0. 

We realise that this might have caused some confusion to players over the last few weeks, which we apologize for. So for any players wondering where to find the Flashlight with this new update, to confirm, it can now be found on a dead expedition member on any basic Radio Tower. Check your Studies Menu.

Look out for the signature blue cable, the Flashlight is on top of the corpse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/5231b1cd091f193c1180819fa27da1bb7bb6170b.png[/img]

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3][b]The Full Changelog[/b][/h3]

There are more additions and changes we could go into more detail about, so instead, we have compiled them here in the full patch notes:

notes.title: Test_Branch Update - Airship Gardening Is Now Live On Beta!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings scientists![/h2]

As announced yesterday, our upcoming Airship Gardening update will be going live for all on 

[h3]March 28th 2024[/h3]

But there is more good news…it’s [b]now live on our beta branch! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/6e50354a537a02b2343d58fe886f17f86bc48629.png[/img]

[i]**Important: Keep in mind that the content on the test branch does not represent the final quality. You’re likely to encounter bugs, typo’s and placeholders**[/i]

This is by far the largest update we’ve released so far, the team have been working hard on this update since the launch of The Frozen Wishes Update back in December, and we hope you enjoy the new content.

We would highly recommend players start a brand new game to fully experience every new change and edition in the Airship Gardening update. Such as improved story, locations and world improvements. Your old saves will still work of course, just you will experience the flow of the new content a little differently. 

Here is a breakdown of the main additions you can expect from this update and the full patch notes…

[h2][b]Airship Gardening Mechanics[/b][/h2]

Gardening will play an important role in the game loop, but also the story. If you wish to keep your gardening setup simple and just what is needed for the story, you can do that. But if you want to go all out with these mechanics, it’s safe to say you should be able to create some really impressive floating greenhouses!

You will be able to add water tanks, and distillers, use different fertilizers, different size pots, a network of pipes, sprinklers and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/7b170a06f67e3cf3ef88ddbe42892b0dc6ad8ae4.gif[/img]

Different pieces of the new gardening tech can be found in several places across our procedurally generated world. Some of the more basic equipment like pots and water tanks are easier to find as they’re placed in more than one location. However, the more advanced technology like Distillers and Water Generators are a tad more rare. Be sure to check your Studies Menu!

In most cases, you will need to plant the seed from the item you want to grow! This process is relatively pain-free as all perishable items like food, medicine and plants now stack in your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/7cf969fda6877e0aed81a0d1ec434af73fbaeaba.gif[/img]

You can increase the speed at which a plant grows by adding a special fertilizer in the Distiller. This fertilizer is made from Rotten Food (yes, it now has a purpose, yay!) Plants that only grow in the Underdust like Breathnuts and more can also be grown, providing you craft the Dust Fertilizer and add it to the garden pot.

[h2][b]Story Chapter 2 - Hunt For The Cure[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/faba426a3f730c2134f2a234c171dba1db94eb19.png[/img]

[h3]CHAPTER 1 RECAP / SPOILERS AHEAD![/h3]

The first chapter of our story came to an end with the Viral Evolution update. We found Noah in the Underdust, then found his research in the Infected Gardens. With that research we were able to craft a hologram which provided the coordinates to the location of the cure that we have been looking for - as was Noah and the previous expedition.

As we mentioned before, gardening will play a role in the next section of the story, as you will soon find out. In addition, we will also be taking our next trip back down to the surface of the planet.

[h2][b]New Underdust Section - Suburbs[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ba75f31cfc7e6317c2a6a6eecd381f83bb3008fc.gif[/img]

This update features a brand new Underdust map for players to explore, The Suburbs. Players will head here during this latest chapter in search of the elusive cure. This map is roughly 4-times larger than the first Underdust map in Chapter 1 and a lot more open. Thankfully, there are a few landmarks to help players get their bearings in this foggy biome AND a Large Oxygen Bottle to make exploration a lot easier.

We hope you have fun down there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/d788d20aafffde0d72b06341b73ba6a924abc874.gif[/img]

Down here you will find a lot of new useful items to collect and new blueprints to research and craft. Including new plants seeds, organic substances for special fertilizers and blueprints for Gardening technology and a new upgraded version of the knife, the Aircutter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/21f441a8baa84aa6c2de3321c94239baae33a5ad.png[/img]

[h3]A side note on combat…[/h3]

With a new exciting Underdust biome to explore, Im sure that many players were hoping to exchange blows with Mantis enemies and more with this update. However, we made the difficult decision to temporarily hold off on this feature, [b]but only for now…[/b]

While we have got combat working in the development stages, we weren’t 100% happy with it and so have decided to spend more time on this feature so it can be better. We keep a watchful eye on other survival games and so we know how passionate survival game players are about this being done right, which is why this decision was made. In addition, we don’t want combat to be isolated in just this one location, we want it to be bigger and better, and so our team will be focusing on this after the launch of the Airship Gardening update.
[h2][b]
Improved World & Story Progression[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/b12c726044790ac6ca3235e477eb3f4815f0f2b9.png[/img]

Not only have we added new story and content with this update, we have also gone back and made improvements to the world and story that already existed in Forever Skies. This was done to make gameplay more engaging and make the story easier to understand. The following was done thanks to your incredible feedback:
[list]
[*] Many mission objectives re-written to give players a better and more immersive experience
[*] Mission Reports - summarizing main quest milestones for the player upon returning to the airship from main quest locations
[*] More lore scenes added 
[*] Story related AI voice lines added
[*] New cutscenes
[*] Design, art and gameplay improvements to existing locations like Radio Towers, Overgrown Radio Towers, Gardens & Descent Lifts.
[*] Several city ruins improved visually
[/list]
Again, we highly recommend players start a fresh save to fully experience all of the above changes. However, if players wish to simply continue from the previous saves and continue the story from where it left off then this is also possible, you just might not experience all of the listed changes above.

[h2][b]New Airship Module Design - “Serenity Range” [/b][/h2]

Airship customization is important in Forever Skies. Because of this, we have added our first new Airship modules, the “Serenity Range”. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/6191a3e3dbdf5168ae2baa91d0354ab680bbe157.png[/img]

These modules can be found on our re-worked data card system - more details below in the full patch notes. We are only getting started with new modules. Coming soon we plan to add additional modules like new cockpits, balloons, exterior modules, stairs and more!

[h2][b]Introducing A New HUD/UI Design[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/e23ff2ad2f2054fce89af7fdfe93073e3b2af4e6.gif[/img]

Airship Gardening introduces a new cleaner HUD design to players. We decided to update our HUD for a few reasons:
[list]
[*] With the changes made to Immunity a few months ago thanks to player feedback, the Immunity Circle on the HUD became redundant as it was no longer a mechanic you would have to manage. Instead immunity is now tied to the story and will change as a scripted event. Your current immunity status can now be found on the Inventory screen.
[*] Cleaner and easier to understand. Certain icons were not explained well in the old design, such as using boosters or diseases. The new HUD displays this in a much clearer manner
[*] Player parameters with distinguished Stamina/Energy and Radiation Zone alerts. 
[/list]
Please let us know your thoughts on the HUD changes. Do you prefer them? Is it an improvement? We’re listening!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2][b]The Full Changelog[/b][/h2]

There are more additions and changes we could go into more detail about, so instead, we have compiled them here in the full patch notes:

[h3]NEW CONTENT:[/h3]

[b]Devices:[/b]
[list]
[*] Small Garden Pot
[*] Small Water Tank
[*] Small Water Sprayer
[*] Large Garden Pot
[*] Large Water Tank
[*] Large Water Sprayer
[*] Water Pipes
[*] Distiller
[*] Pipe Water Generator
[/list]

[b]Tools:[/b]
[list]
[*] Aircutter  
[*] Big Oxygen Tank 
[*] Magnetic Lure - Catch other items in addition to food
[/list]

[b]Plants & seeds:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sleeping Lily plant
[*] Leafire plant
[*] North Stari plant
[*] Pig Smile plant
[*] Sleeping Lily seeds
[*] Leafire seeds
[*] North Stari seeds
[*] Pig Smile seeds
[*] Breathnut seeds
[*] Petit Bruiseflower seeds
[*] Bruiseflower seeds
[*] Petit Astre seeds
[*] Canola Multidoigt seeds
[*] Coffee Nut seeds
[*] Dust Daisy seeds
[*] Green Colander seeds
[*] Inkbulb seeds
[*] Lobster Pepper seeds
[*] Meteor Bean seeds
[*] Sunmelon seeds
[/list]

[b]Food:[/b]
[list]
[*] Boiled Leafire
[*] Boiled Pig Smile
[/list]

[b]Resources:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dust Fertilizer
[*] Sulfur Fertilizer
[*] Mantis Feces 
[*] Chitin
[/list]

[b]Paints:[/b]
[list]
[*] “Bloom” theme
[/list]

[b]Decorations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Poster “Automatic Irrigation System”
[*] Poster “Sprinkler”
[/list]

[b]Airship Modules:[/b]
[list]
[*] Serenity Wall
[*] Serenity Window
[*] Serenity Floor / Ceiling
[*] Serenity Door
[/list]

[b]Player:[/b]
[list]
[*] Current immunity level can be seen in the Inventory / Backpack menu
[*] Chronic diseases - when your immunity is Low, diseases become more dangerous and need more specialized ways of treatment (waiting them out no longer works)
[/list]

[b]Narration:[/b]
[list]
[*] Chapter 2 of the story - in order to find a cure for a virus that slowly kills you, you have to travel to the depths of the Underdust to find a century long lost cure
[*] Mission Reports - summarizing main quest milestones for the player upon returning to the airship from main quest locations
[*] New lore scenes for second Lift and Underdust locations
[*] Gardening tutorials in data tablets
[*] Chronic Diseases tutorial
[*] New cutscenes added
[/list]

[b]World:[/b]
[list]

[/list]

[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Magnetic Fishing Lure - allow catching things other than food

[*] HUD improvements - player parameters with a clearly distinguished Stamina/Energy and radiation zones alerts; Flashlight power status added
[*] Perishable food, plants and medicine now stack in player's inventory
[/list]

[h3]CHANGED:[/h3]

[b]Player:[/b]
[list]
[*] Immunity reworked - it changes with the story progress only; it affects the probability of infection after getting in touch with virus carriers; you cannot prevent those losses  but you can find a ways to improve it temporarily
[*] All Viruses researches displayed in Studies menu after crafting Virus Sample Analyzer
[*] Fungal Meningitis name changed to Meningitis
[*] Medical Bed role in disease loop improved (e.g. gives a free Immunity booster)
[*] Flashlight can be found on a corpse on Radio Tower locations
[/list]

[b]Narration:[/b]
[list]
[*] The main quest path reworked - it should be more immersive and understandable
[*] Sagittarius expedition dead crew members locations slightly changed - to differentiate them from the remains of the last people living on the Earth centuries ago
[/list]

[b]World:[/b]
[list]
[*] Greenhouse Towers - additional gates in radiation sheds
[*] Overgrown Towers - refactored, paths are more visible, source of early gardening devices and consumables
[*] Radio Towers - design and art improvements
[*] Airship workstation moved to the 1st Underdust Lift location
[*] Wrecked Automatic Deck Extractor moved to a Greenhouse Tower
[*] Wrecked Filtering Deck Extractor moved to an Infected garden
[*] Wrecked Upgrade Station moved to first Underdust
[*] Slightly reduced amount of small locations to be found in the world
[*] Underdust Oxygen refillers are more visible
[*] Epoxy resource was moved to the Underdust; small amounts could be still found on a Greenhouse Tower locations but are now behind a progression gate
[*] Slightly reduced amount of plants in the world
[*] Descent to the Underdust - battery next to the computer was removed
[/list]

[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Data Cards distribution reworked - you won’t find new paint themes for example unless you’ve researched and crafted the Paint tool; Data Cards will spawns more frequently.
[*] Crossbow sound effects updated
[*] Medical Bed / Station animation tweaks
[*] Many performance tweaks
[/list]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3]How To Access the Test Branch[/h3]
[list]
[*] Open the Steam application on your PC and locate Forever Skies in your games library
[*] Right click - PROPERTIES- BETAS
[*] Put in the password: BlimpWorkshop
[*] From the dropdown menu select the beta branch tilted: beta_flight
[*] Press the blue “Opt into beta_flight…” button
[*] In your Games Library click on Forever Skies [beta_flight]
[*] Install the Test Branch
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/61c2d01e45be73613aaa00be562f736b47406c25.png[/img]

[h3]How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch[/h3]

Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:
[list]
[*] Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[*] C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\
[*] Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
[*] Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[*] C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\
[*] Paste your copied save file into this location
[*] As a precaution make a 2nd copy of your save file and paste it somewhere on your desktop or in a safe folder. This way you can ensure you have a clean, backup save just in case.
[/list]

After you have done the above, you can start the Forever Skies Test Branch from Steam and your save will be present when you select “CONTINUE”

[h3]Existing Saves Won’t be Affected but use an Imported Save To Play the Test Branch[/h3]

Your existing saves, progress, and any custom settings you’ve set in from the main game won’t be carried over to the Test Branch. Your pc will see this as if you are installing and playing the game for the first time ever. Likewise, by playing on the Test Branch, your main saves should not be affected at all.

This also means any progress on the test branch will not be carried over to the main game once the update is live. The test branch is designed to allow you to explore and test new features without impacting your current progress.

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. Instructions on how to do it can be found below.

[h3][b]Where to Submit Bugs[/b][/h3]

All bugs or issues that you encounter while playing should be submitted via the FEEDBACK TOOL that you can find in-game when pausing the game. Subsequently, you can find the tool under this link too:

https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests

Thats all for now, speak soon!
