notes.title: Let's Take A Look At Airship Gardening
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings scientists[/h2]

We’ve been pretty quiet since the last patch, so we figured we'd shared some more details about the upcoming Airship Gardening update! This update keeps getting bigger (we’re going to need plenty of coffee putting the changelog together) 

We will have more details soon about what else you can expect and the exact release date, but today let's focus on what you can grow.

[h3][b]Let's Talk Airship Gardening![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/7b170a06f67e3cf3ef88ddbe42892b0dc6ad8ae4.gif[/img]

If players wish, gardening can be kept simple. Having just a few plant pots is totally fine and acceptable. But, taking it to the next level has a whole bunch of benefits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/0a937b931fb0a79d2f7bf559c24d3f57f476013b.gif[/img]

To create an autonomous and sustaining airship garden, you will need a selection of new technologies that will be found in various locations around the world:

🌊Water Tanks
🧪Distillers
👩‍🔧A pipe network
🌧️Sprinklers
🌷Plant pots
+ more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/7cf969fda6877e0aed81a0d1ec434af73fbaeaba.gif[/img]

[h3][b]What Can You Grow & How?[/b][/h3]

Flowers and plants you find like Ink Bulbs, Petit Astre, Bruiseflower etc can be grown in Small Garden Pots. Crops you find growing on larger plants like Sunmelon, Coffee Nut, Green Collander etc can be grown in Big Garden Pots.

In most cases, you will need to plant the seed from the item you want to grow! We plan for this process to be pain-free as food and seeds inventory stacking is currently in the testing phase of production! Providing there is no negative impact on the gameplay loop, this will be a part of the update!

You can increase the speed at which a plant grows by adding a special fertilizer in the Distiller. This fertilizer is made from Rotten Food (yes, it now has a purpose, yay!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/e90b441ae130284fa271ac9287bbb54dd8514fc4.gif[/img]

Plants that only grow in the Underdust like Breathnuts and more can also be grown, providing you craft the Dust Fertilizer and add it to the garden pot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/08db5b4193feb800f81f9c5b6443da3709469c96.gif[/img]

What do you think? Let us know in the comments. There will also be another dev log very soon where we plan to show you more content from this update!

Thank you for reading, speak soon!

Team Far From Home

notes.title: Early Access Ends in 2024 | Quality-Of-Life Patch (EA.1.4.2) Is Out Now!
notes.content:
Greetings scientists!

We have quite a few bits of news to share with you today, so buckle up!

[b][h2]1. EARLY ACCESS PLANNED TO COMPLETE IN 2024[/h2][/b]

Today we announced that our team is on-track to release the full version of Forever Skies in late 2024. 

We don’t have an exact day and month for you yet because we ourselves will only know that closer to the end of development. We also need to see how the work and feedback on our next big updates go. But rest assured, once we know and feel the date works for our team we will announce it.

And yes, co-op is still planned to be added before the release of the final version. Our work there is progressing well but we are still adamant that it will be released once we feel it is ready.

[b][h2]2. WE HAVE PARTNERED WITH SONY[/h2][/b]

Our next big news is that we have partnered with Sony! We have actually been quietly working with them for a few years but today we can make it official. 

With their help we have been able to focus on making Forever Skies the best it can be for its console debut. So, at the end of PC Early Access when we're ready to release the full game, we'll be launching it exclusively on PlayStation 5 for consoles [b]and Steam on the same day. [/b]

We released a new trailer and got a cool story on PS Blog about the inspiration behind the game. You can check out both here:

[url=https://blog.playstation.com/2024/02/15/how-a-toxic-world-inspired-forever-skies-a-first-person-sci-fi-survival-game/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/74fce3851491a89c6fdcfd508c5b6653ae095861.png[/img][/url]
[previewyoutube=jNrhydUfH_I;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]3. 20% SALE + RIFTBREAKER BUNDLE[/h2][/b]

Along with the news and new patch (see the bulk below) we’ve got a 20% sale on Steam right now. We also have our ongoing bundle with The Riftbreaker live still. 

The Riftbreaker is what would happen if Diablo and Starcraft had a baby. Mechs, base-building, survival, and hack-and-slash combat all in one. You are an elite scientist/commando inside an advanced Mecha-Suit sent to terraform a hostile alien planet. Hack & slash swarms of enemies, build up your base, collect samples, and research new inventions to survive.

If you already own Forever Skies you can use the bundle to get an additional 15% off from The Riftbreaker

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37896/FOREVER_SKIES_X_THE_RIFTBREAKER/

[b][h2]4. NEW QUALITY OF LIFE PATCH IS LIVE![/h2][/b]

The Quality-Of-Life patch - EA.1.4.2 ha arrived and includes QOL improvements, bug fixes and gives much-needed love to the forgotten tool of Forever Skies, The Flashlight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/fec50d95b8557a1a4eaf5a79a491a3b50d1eee9c.gif[/img]

[b]New(ish) Item: The Flashlight[/b]

Finally, after 7 months in Early Access all players will know that they can use a Flashlight in game!

The blueprint for this tool can be acquired early on after visiting your first Radio Tower and collecting some Electrical Parts. This will prompt the blueprint to unlock, at which point the player can research it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/6ccf01becacbd35427b313564cf86f558df6c4c2.gif[/img]

Players don’t need to worry about another item taking up valuable inventory space as The Flashlight gets its own dedicated slot, in the same way as your Oxygen Tank. It now runs on batteries and will need to be charged like most tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/73a15a9f29459f7a103f2e4eb3e725b8ff209097.gif[/img]

[b]QOL Improvement: Airship Base Adjustments[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/d6de9d58dbd95de143b99580be6c7d534419475e.gif[/img]

If you’re replacing any normal wall module with a Door, then any attachments you had on the wall will simply drop into your inventory, unless you’re inventory is full. And with Patch 1.4.2, that just got easier too!

[b]QOL Improvement: Inventory Management[/b]

Your inventory, storage boxes, and freezers have had a couple of new functions added to make moving items around easier than ever.

[i]Store All[/i] - This will remove all items currently in your inventory and move them into the storage box/freezer that you’re interacting with.

[i]Take All[/i] - This will move all items in that Storage Box or Freezer into your Inventory.

[i]Sort [/i]- This one is self-explanatory, it will sort all of your items so slots are more organized and will group stacks of the same item together.

[i]Store Similar [/i]- This function is useful when you have a Storage Box for a specific resource. It will remove the item or resource out of your inventory that matches the item or resource that’s already in the Storage Box, meaning you don’t have to comb through your inventory to find that stack of Machine Parts you want to store. It can be done at the click of a button once you interact with your Machine Parts Storage Box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/d91f566d4b0a19d134fd21c0494497d22b12f9b0.gif[/img]

----------------------------------------------------------

[h2][b]Full Patch Notes:[/b][/h2]


[h3][b]New elements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Flashlight added as an equipable and rechargeable player’s tool
[/list]

[h3][b]QoL improvements:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Inventory sorting and stacking added, also in various containers
[*] “Deposit All” option added - the ability to deposit all container-specific items into a container with a single click
[*] “Deposit Similar” - the ability to deposit all items from the Inventory that are of the same type as the items in the container.
[*] “Take All” option added - the ability to take all items from a single container into inventory
[*] Changes to the quest progression in the Underdust location:
[/list]- Most of the sub-quests were rewritten to give a better understanding of the quest progression

- Removed Battery used to power up the lift in the Descent to the Underdust location

- Path to the Lab in the Underdust should be more accessible

- Lab section slightly changed, e.g. Medical Reagents, crucial in the progression, are more exposed 

- Dead Virus Carrier lore tablet, crucial in the progression, is more exposed

[list]
[*] Airship wall and floor types can now be changed without the need to remove attached devices and artifacts (which previously blocked such changes)
[*] Interaction with the Cooking Station should now be accessible only from the front of the device
[*] Note Sticker - action buttons switched - holding E now enters edit mode
[*] Immunity Booster now blocks any new virus infections for its duration
[*] While being infected with any given virus, another infection with the same virus resets its timer
[*] Thunderstorms should now be less frequent (approx. twice less often)
[*] Database - locations’ entries’ background images added
[*] Basic Engine Thrusters’ visuals improved
[*] Boiled Lulling Grass Cricket’s icon changed to differentiate it more from the raw Cricket
[*] Boiled Dust Lettuce’s icon changed to differentiate it more from the raw Lettuce
[*] The Chromatic Aberration toggle option was added to the Settings 
[*] Thunderstorm volume slider added to the Audio Settings
[/list]

[h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Flying debris can’t damage an airship, while it’s docked at the Descent to the Underdust location
[*] The player no longer dies after using the Medical Station while being infected with Hemorrhagic Fever
[*] Storage Boxes cannot be placed on other Storage Boxes anymore
[*] Insect Catcher no longer works when it’s in collision with parts of locations
[*] Damaged Upgraded Turbines no longer reset their health state upon being picked up
[*] To-Do list no longer marks already-seen tasks as new
[*] Souvenir Mug’s icon now matches the in-game mesh
[*] Thorn Bee Hives placement fixed - they shouldn’t spawn in strange places anymore
[*] Music tracks should play and change while exploring various locations
[*] A glass wall with door frame scanning description fixed
[*] Breathnut descriptions now show how much oxygen it replenishes
[*] Immunity is reset to the proper value after the player dies
[*] Minor typos in text fixed
[/list]

[h3][b]Known issues:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Shadows flicker badly while an airship is moving (the more noticeable the lower quality settings)
[*] Some broken crates may appear as not damaged
[*] Database - some icons are missing in the locations’ entries
[/list]

That's all for now! 
Team Far From Home

[h2][h1]How To Access the Test Branch[/h1][/h2]

[*] Put in the password: [i][b]BlimpWorkshop[/b][/i]
[*] From the dropdown menu select the beta branch tilted: beta_flight

[*] In your Games Library click on [b][i]Forever Skies [beta_flight][/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/77700a99e25b4c21ab3566232fdab27fd15820c0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/690071a74b425660396d8207700e8ea1cb1a4418.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/83781dbba7c3ee87d802ed3187589b8b2df9bc45.jpg[/img]

[h2]How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch[/h2]

Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:

[list]
[*] Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[i][b]C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\[/b][/i]
[*] Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
[*] Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[i][b]C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\[/b][/i]
[*] Paste your copied save file into this location
[*] As a precaution make a 2nd copy of your save file and paste it somewhere on your desktop or in a safe folder. This way you can ensure you have a clean, backup save just in case.
[/list]

After you have done the above, you can start the Forever Skies Test Branch from Steam and your save will be present when you select “CONTINUE”


[h2]Existing Saves Won’t be Affected but use an Imported Save To Play the Test Branch[/h2]

Your existing saves, progress, and any custom settings you’ve set in from the main game won’t be carried over to the Test Branch. Your pc will see this as if you are installing and playing the game for the first time ever. Likewise, by playing on the Test Branch, your main saves should not be affected at all.

This also means any progress on the test branch will not be carried over to the main game once the update is live. The test branch is designed to allow you to explore and test new features without impacting your current progress.

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. Instructions on how to do it can be found below.  


[b]Where to Submit Bugs[/b]

All bugs or issues that you encounter while playing should be submitted via the FEEDBACK TOOL that you can find in-game when pausing the game. Subsequently, you can find the tool under this link too:
https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests

notes.title: Whale and Dolphin Conservation Charity Artifact Added
notes.content:
Hello Scientists!

As some of you may remember, our team has been partnering with the UK charity organization Whale And Dolphin Conservation (WDC) for some time now.

This year we wanted to up our support for them, so we created a special unique item that players can purchase and put on their airship called the Whale and Dolphin Conservation Artifact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/9de4ab794375f4f44bf647b85666598a65fd472b.png[/img]

[h2]100% of Proceeds Go to Whale and Dolphin Conservation[/h2]

We have set this so that 100% of the net revenue from this item goes directly to WDC to further help WDC’s vital conservation efforts.

[h3]NOTE: This DLC is a one-off initiative from our team to help a charity that we firmly believe in, hence why we are committing 100% of the proceeds to WDC.[/h3]

[b]Rest assured we will not be making any further paid DLC for Forever Skies until we finish Early Access. You have already paid for the game and we will deliver the full version of it to everyone. This item is just for those who would like to join us in supporting a wonderful cause.[/b]

[h2]About the Whale and Dolphin Conservation Artifact[/h2]

The artifact is a holographic globe that depicts two dolphins swimming through eternity. The item can be placed almost anywhere around your airship and can be interacted with to change color.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/933191b413f5ef763ebea30ea44ecd3c8cee1703.png[/img]

Anyone who buys the item will automatically have the item added to their fabricator items under the INTERIORS section to be printed out. You can print as many as you want and each print requires 6 units of Synthetics.

notes.title: BETA_TEST BRANCH UPDATE - SEASONAL EVENT - FROZEN WISHES
notes.content:
[h2][h1]Greetings testing branch scientists![/h1][/h2]

The Seasonal Event - Frozen Wishes update is now live on our beta_flight branch for you to test RIGHT NOW! Here are some of the features you can expect…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/fa76bce9f5ecc80593b7ce20a9118469665bf04f.png[/img]

This update introduces our first Seasonal Event - Frozen Wishes! It is a little quest and a special location we have prepared, but that’s not all. We’re also including new features, items, locations, QOL improvements and loads of bug fixes. Just look at the changelog below! 

Thank you to every player that clicked the SEND FEEDBACK option in the pause menu, we wouldn’t have been able to get to this many fixes without your reports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/fdb047d6338bf3617d6c60b95e75d9941b85674e.gif[/img]

“Oh, the weather outside is frightful…”

[h2][h1]Update Change Log[/h1][/h2]

IMPORTANT NOTE - At this moment this update is only available in EN. The final release next week will be fully localised. 

Here is everything included in this update…

NEW ELEMENTS:
[list]
[*] Seasonal Event - Frozen Wishes
     - An Old Request” quest 
     - Weather - Snow & Blizzard
[*] Location - Desolated Radio Tower
[*] Device -  Large Freezer
[*] Airship Decors
    - Half-Railings (left and right)
    - Symmetrical Half-Railings
    - New designs for standard railings
[*] Immunity System Redefined
    - Player disease symptoms added
[*] Sitting mechanic
[/list]
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS:
[list]
[*] Players can now place many interior objects on their airship’s exterior
[*] Tool Charger - adding battery should be easier now
[*] Crustpede balance - now it deals less damage
[*] Virus Sample Analyzer balance - single Crystal battery lasts for 5 usages
[*] Engines and Turbines can be placed on Ladder Room’s frame
[*] Engines and Turbines animations added
[*] Eating meals directly from the Cooking Station shows proper Database entries
[*] Quantity of crafted items is being shown while using Basic Fabricator
[*] Crystal Fuel crafting and recycling time decreased
[*] Airship Builder can now build Catwalks through doors and makeshift walls
[*] Airship Builder can now build Doors on the Observatory Corner room
[*] Players can recycle additional Deck Extractors (except for one, in case of emergencies)
[*] 1080p monitors can use windowed 1920x1080 resolution
[/list]
FIXES:
[list]
[*] Synthetics are pickable after recycling Empty Bottle in the Recycler
[*] Research Station cannot be recycled anymore
[*] Additional Research Station doesn’t disappear from the Recycler after loading a saved game
[*] "Find an Overgrown Glasshouse" quest fixed and changed slightly - you have to check the computer now to progress (this should fix the problem with being stuck with progression on this quest)
[*] The task “Check new discovered objects in Studies Menu” now requires–as it should–opening the Studies menu
[*] Players shouldn’t get stuck in the Medical Station anymore
[*] Medical Station is not consuming Preternatural Seeds when not working
[*] Medical Station is no longer duplicating Preternatural Seeds after loading a saved game
[*] The player should not be able to access Docking Plank’s controls if they’re standing on the extended plank
[*] Water Condenser and its membrane are available in the Basic Fabricator from the beginning
[*] Improved Water Condenser to allow water generation if there is any space left and prevent from generating more than it should
[*] Automatic Extractor’s panel colours should be less confusing now
[*] Fishing Rod and Advanced Fishing Rod devices now snap properly during placement
[*] Inventory - fixed inability to change slots for critical devices (Basic Fabricator, Deck Extractor, Research Station)
[*] Cooking Station water level is shown properly after loading a saved game
[*] Dropped bottle will not be considered an “Empty Bottle” if it’s not really empty
[*] Seam in the middle of Small Cockpit has been removed
[*] Posters no longer block entry to some sheds
[*] Broken Crates visual changes after repairing should show properly
[*] Players can climb down the ladder in the Ladder Room if there is a glass floor installed
[*] Players can climb down the ladder in the Ladder Room even if there are some devices placed in front of the ladder
[*] Players research progress is no longer stuck at 94 - 96%; when they find everything it shows 100% completion
[*] Medicines now have proper printing animation added
[*] Medicines have proper icons in the Database
[*] First Aid Kit can now be unlocked by scanning or picking up Lobster Chili
[*] The quest marker for an Overgrown Glasshouse should now always be visible after crafting the Location Radar
[*] Crustpedes on locations load faster when loading a saved game
[*] Infected Gardens chain quests can no longer be exploited by saving and loading a saved game
[*] To-Do list menu - finished quests are no longer marked with an orange dot
[*] Thorn Bee Honey shows the proper object while using it in the Virus Sample Analyzer
[*] Thorn Bee hive no longer spawns in the dirty water pool on the Overgrown Glasshouse location
[*] Thorn Bee hive should always fall in the reach of player after shooting / cutting it down
[*] Underdust's Thorns Bee Hives - they generate 3 Honey resources, so player can progress with Underdust quest path without the need to leave the location to hunt for resources
[*] Notifications or Tutorial prompts lead to the right Database entries
[*] Clean Water has been added to the Database
[*] Breathnut is being shown in the proper Database category
[*] Breathnut shows how much Oxygen it restores
[*] Breathnut is highlighted properly while using Scanner
[*] Friendly Insect is highlighted properly while using Scanner
[*] Posters are highlighted properly while using Scanner
[*] Mantis Glands are no longer a part of any recipe, nor can they be analyzed for viruses (they will have some other usage in upcoming updates)
[*] Airship Builder should no longer lead to accidentally blurring out the screen
[*] Airship building - catwalks can be built properly adjacent to Observatory Corner and Cockpits
[*] Photophobia shouldn’t happen from other sources than a clearly visible Sun
[*] Photophobia visual effects shouldn’t be applied to a player while they're looking at the sun through plastic floor/ceilings
[*] Fixed no in-game sound issue after pressing ESC during loading screen
[*] Fixed error messages not lasting long enough on the screen
[*] Crustpede and Boiled Crustpede Database description fixed
[*] Oxygen Tanks descriptions fixed, as to not suggest it being as additional source of Oxygen
[*] “Open” prompt on doors is being shown only when doors remain closed
[*] “Use Item Printer” prompt is being shown on Basic Fabricator only

[*] Many visual fixes (airship construction objects, falling Blockade, Tool Charger clipping, catwalks decals, z-fights, lift floor etc.)
[*] Minor sound fixes
[*] Minor text fixes
[*] Additional performance improvements
[/list]

[h2][h1]How To Access the Test Branch[/h1][/h2]

[list]
[*] Open the Steam application on your PC and locate Forever Skies in your games library
[*] Right click - PROPERTIES- BETAS
[*] Put in the password: [i][b]BlimpWorkshop[/b][/i]
[*] From the dropdown menu select the beta branch tilted: beta_flight
[*] Press the blue “Opt into beta_flight…” button
[*] In your Games Library click on [b][i]Forever Skies [beta_flight][/i][/b]
[*] Install the Test Branch
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/77700a99e25b4c21ab3566232fdab27fd15820c0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/690071a74b425660396d8207700e8ea1cb1a4418.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/83781dbba7c3ee87d802ed3187589b8b2df9bc45.jpg[/img]

[h2]How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch[/h2]

Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:

[list]
[*] Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[i][b]C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\[/b][/i]
[*] Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
[*] Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[i][b]C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\[/b][/i]
[*] Paste your copied save file into this location
[*] As a precaution make a 2nd copy of your save file and paste it somewhere on your desktop or in a safe folder. This way you can ensure you have a clean, backup save just in case.
[/list]

After you have done the above, you can start the Forever Skies Test Branch from Steam and your save will be present when you select “CONTINUE”


[h2]Existing Saves Won’t be Affected but use an Imported Save To Play the Test Branch[/h2]

Your existing saves, progress, and any custom settings you’ve set in from the main game won’t be carried over to the Test Branch. Your pc will see this as if you are installing and playing the game for the first time ever. Likewise, by playing on the Test Branch, your main saves should not be affected at all.

This also means any progress on the test branch will not be carried over to the main game once the update is live. The test branch is designed to allow you to explore and test new features without impacting your current progress.

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. Instructions on how to do it can be found below.  

[h2]Where to Submit Bugs[/h2]

All bugs or issues that you encounter while playing should be submitted via the FEEDBACK TOOL that you can find in-game when pausing the game. Subsequently, you can find the tool under this link too: 

[h3][url=https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests]https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests[/url][/h3]

Performance on Under the Dust location was improved but we’re not done with it yet - expect more to come!

[list]
[*] Crustpede’s and Crustpede Meat's icons and model were changed

[*] Fixed some crates that were spawned in floors
[*] Fixed an issue with the airship getting damaged by thunderstorms while docked at a location
[*] Fixed an issue where the airship could undock itself from its location
[*] Immunity should no longer drop while on tutorial location
[*] Mantis and Mantis glands now show proper scannable material

[*] Fixed issues with Garden location not spawning or spawning in mountains

[*] Fixed various floating elements on Rooftop location
[*] Crossbow research should now only appear once in the Research Station
[*] Added collisions to some of the skyscrapers that were missing
[*] Fixed position of a few Crustpedes that were spawning in the air
[*] There is now a limit to how many Crustpedes can spawn on a location
[*] Fixed the position of some resources that could not be picked up
[*] Fixed some performance issues linked to the storm
[*] Fixed an Icon for Immunity Booster in the HUD
[*] Fixed an issue with loading saves from a previous patch where a completed virus research that no longer exists or has been modified would not grant the proper rewards.
[/list]

[h3]Known issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] After creating the Location Radar, the quest marker for the Garden location might not appear. In this case, the player might have to travel further for the marker to appear.

[/list]

-----------------------------------------------------

That is all for now. We now working on our next big update but you can expect more fixes as we sort them. Thanks and as always, keep talking to us!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/f64397d9771a986f68745104b48d2e01c1bce6e2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Greetings Forever Skies community![/h2]

Get your Airship Builder tools at the ready, Scientists, it's time to launch the [h3]Forever Skies Community Airship Building Contest![/h3]

We can’t wait to see what kind of imaginative bases you can create. The winner will receive a [b]Geforce RTX 4080 graphics card and an exclusive Discord role[/b].

[h2]HOW TO ENTER & RULES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Contest entries will be accepted only in Discord in the dedicated channel. [url=https://discord.gg/foreverskies]Join our Discord here.[/url] 
[*] Each entry must have it’s own thread within the channel (details of how to do this can be found in the channel itself)
[*] Each player can submit ONE entry only
[*] Players can submit their entry with either a minimum of 5 screenshots, or a short video. 
[*] Go into as much detail as possible. You have a higher chance of winning by documenting your airship well and also by using the Remove HUD feature by pressing F3 to give an unobstructed view.
[*] The screenshots have to be the player's own capture, no official Forever Skies screens can be used.
[*] Screenshots have to be taken in-game (no HUD is preferable). No third-party software can be used to alter images. E.G. Photoshop.
[*] Airships with unofficial balloons from mods will not be accepted.
[*] We reserve the right to publish and use your screenshots in Forever Skies promotions
[*] Employees and partners of Far From Home are not eligible to enter - this includes their families.
[*] This contest is for players in USA, Canada, EU, Australia, Norway, Switzerland, Australia, Ukraine, Turkey and UK only
[*] The winner will be decided by members of the studio, Far From Home.
[*] The full terms and conditions can be [url=https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/post/regulations-of-the-online-competition-forever-skies-airship-building-contest]found here.[/url]
[*] By submitting an entry you accept these Terms & Conditions by default.
[/list]

[h2]JUDGING CRITERIA[/h2]

Entries will be judged on three different criteria:

[b]Ambition[/b]: How bold is your airship design, does it use the building, painting and decorating system effectively?

[b]Aesthetics[/b]: Does your build make us stop and stare? Does it have the “wow” factor?

[b]Practicality[/b]: How useful is your airship for your scientific adventure? Is it practical or is it just for show?

The competition will end on [b]November 28th 2023![/b] Are you ready? Let’s build some blimps!

Team Far From Home

[list]
[*] More objectives 
[*] New lore scenes and tablets 
[/list]

[b]Balance changes to existing mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stamina balance has been changed to be more forgiving
[*] Natural health regeneration is slightly lowered
[*] Endurance Booster now will regenerate stamina quickly rather than stopping it from depleting
[/list]
[b]
Fixes & Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Active boosters remaining times do not reset after death
[*] Fixed an issue with a trigger for picking up water from Water Condenser
[*] Automatic Deck Extractor performance improved
[*] You can now place some raw Foods in Virus Station
[*] Stamina consumption tweaks - decreased stamina consumption and increased stamina regeneration
[*] Difficulty level tweaks (Hard should now be slightly easier) 
[*] Virus samples can’t be produced in the Basic Fabricator any more. Create them in the Virus Sample Analyzer only.
[*] “Hide HUD” default key changed from H to F3
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/adc3f56834d177e4f469c08fb76e274cc17f8359.png[/img]
[b]Changes to how the Immunity System works:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Immunity System has been reworked. Previously it was directly connected to the sum of your individual stats. Now your Immunity will slowly rise and fall, depending on how well you manage your basic needs. For example, if your character has full bars on Energy, Health and Nutrition, but very low Hydration, your Immunity will slowly drop. If all of your needs are unmet, your Immunity will drop quite quickly - but when you fulfil the needs, it will regenerate naturally. You can also find Immunity-regenerating items - be on the lookout for those!
High Immunity will shield you from Virus contraction. As viruses are now much more prevalent, you should focus on keeping Immunity as high as possible.
[/list]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Finally, we would recommend starting a new save in order to fully experience this new content but it isn’t 100% necessary. Your previous saves will also work, however some players might need to travel a short while in order for the new content to trigger.

Don’t forget to leave us a review, it really helps us out! 🙂

Team Far From Home

notes.title: "The Thrower Is Mightier Than The Patch" Patch Is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings scientists![/h2]

The September patch - EA.1.2.0 (#23490) has finally arrived and includes some new items, fixes & QOL improvements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/dafaf39bf664451386989f4680b2c6bfa4fb4939.png[/img]

[h3]NEW ITEM: The Repair Thrower[/h3]

Finally, the upgrade for the humble Repair Patch has arrived in Forever Skies! Players can find the blueprint for the Repair Thrower in a [b]new room in the Underdust biome[/b], complete with its consumable “ammunition”, Repair Foam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/b246ae85da67a56185033f2cf6ac188bea5bff15.gif[/img]

The Repair Thrower is a more advanced, methodical and satisfying method of fixing damage to your airship base, than the Repair Patch. This new tool even comes with a handy radar device at the back, that guides you to the damaged parts of your airship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/1a4a1c6840441bb42e4be5b629770fd371b903ef.gif[/img]

[i]New room added to the Underdust where you will find the tools blueprint and other useful items.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/a381c8b2cb2e6016152c9eb433d083afb85eda76.png[/img]

[h3]NEW ITEM: Damaged Boxes[/h3]

You will now find boxes scattered around the world both above and below the dust. These boxes contain useful items inside. However, the box itself is damaged, meaning the player is unable to access the contents. These boxes will require fixing with Repair Foam first in order to claim the items inside!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/9e825a8c3363f1ef35971d96ded2dbac1bbc9d49.png[/img]

[h3]FIXED: Pet Now Obtainable If Missed[/h3]

Tell me if this sounds familiar, you were exploring the tunnels in the Underdust until you were attacked by a Mantis. This caused a [i]*mild*[/i] panic and you got out of dodge the first chance you got. Except wait, you later found out that the pet was not accessible to you because of your earlier [i]*ahem*[/i] “tactical retreat”. Well fear no more, we have fixed this error. The pet can now be obtained if you missed it the first time! It can now be found waiting for you in the tunnel, just outside of where you first came across the Mantis’. So head on back to claim your new pet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/f5e0bc71d949e84d7306636684ca6c00046e9d54.png[/img]

[h3]QOL IMPROVEMENTS UI & HUD:[/h3]

Remove HUD option has now been added! Now you can take screenshots of the beautifully damaged world, or perhaps your behemoth Airship without the HUD getting in the way!

Other improvements have been made to our UI, including improved stack splitting! Stacks now split in half, not just by single items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/d3fad96bb7a89622e5a0014876a296248a64bb29.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------

[h2]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h2]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]

[list]
[*] Repair Thrower and Repair Foam added
[*] Damaged boxes containing items added into gameloop
[*] New secret room added to Underdust, housing the Repair Thrower blueprint
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Pet is now obtainable for players who missed it the first time.
[*] Improvements made to drag and drop function when removing unwanted items from your inventory.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] “Climb on board” functionality added to Docking Plank
[*] Stack splitting improvements. Players can now split stack by whichever desired amount they want.
[*] Freezer improvements - Freezer now fully pauses item spoiling.
[*] HUD Removal option can now be actived in the Settings menu.

[*] Various other small fixes and re-balances.
[/list]

That’s all for now, coming up we have teases for the October Update and more. 
See you then!

Team Far From Home

notes.title: Your Questions Answered | Part Two
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings scientists![/h2]

I won't waste your time with preamble, lets get straight into Part Two with CEO & Gameplay Lead, Andrzej Blumenfeld and Creative Director, Tomek Wlazlo!

[h3]Lets begin![/h3]

[h3][b]Will we see new types of towers added?[/b][/h3]
From: Plum [Discord]

[TW] Yes! We will absolutely add additional location types, and not just variants of the current types. These will be story locations and we look forward to sharing more of these with you in the future.

[h3][b]Will we get ranged weapons other than the crossbow? and what will they be?[/b][/h3]
From: Plonk [Discord]

[AB] We're planning to expand the use and need of the crossbow more before adding new stuff. New types of bolts, possibly an upgraded version, etc. So for now, we don't have any plans for other ranged weapons but this doesn't mean we won't add it in the future. If the gameplay warrants more ranged weapons, then we'll add them.

[h3][b]I've seen hammocks left from previous inhabitants on locations. Can we get these on our airship as an alternative to the bed please?[/b][/h3]
From: Mobin [Discord]

[TW] We understand some of you really want to feel like sky pirates so ok, we'll consider it. :)

[h3][b]Are there any plans for weekly or biweekly game development updates? something with bit of news, maybe showing off a screenshot or two of new models, technical challenges overcome, that kind of thing[/b][/h3]
From: Dingo [Discord]

[AB] Im glad you asked! Not weekly, but Greg our Community Manager will start a monthly round-up YouTube video. We plan to start it with the first large update planned for October. In the video we will cover whats happening in the studio, the community, any events happening and hopefully more! We also plan to post in Steam and on socials when the latest video goes up.

[h3][b]What's the next priority based on the items on the flight map? Can you share an anticipated timeline with us?[/b][/h3]
From: Entirago [Discord]

[TW] Next priority for us is "threats". That includes viruses, methods of dealing with threats and some enemies that will come somewhere around October. You can see a sneak peek in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1641960/view/3669924544085165512?l=english]latest Steam post[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/acceded064beb48491e89ae3264dfe7d6685f06f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/f2e9764001fb58ebfe7e9e7585b77632ab7e4214.png[/img]

[h3][b]What are we most looking forward to in terms of unreleased content?[/b][/h3]
From: Ematai {Discord}

[AB] Without a doubt, co-op. It is a tough nut to crack development-wise, but the reward of getting to push each other off the airship is what keeps driving us.

[h3][b]When can we expect Accessibility options such as increased text and icon sizes?[/b][/h3]
From: Marcus Perry [Steam]

[AB] We know that text on some of our windows is on the smaller side and we do plan to deal with is in the future, however we don't have a date set for it yet. We already tried to address this once but found out the biggest hurdle here is languages that use other alphabets as they react a lot differently to the the Latin alphabet. So we need to find a moment in our development plans where we can assign someone to this with more time to problem solve and test.

[h3][b]Any chance of getting a ship-wide energy system like solar panels for example?[/b][/h3]
From: Illuminia [Steam]

[TW] It is an idea that has been floated around a few times but actually works counter to other ideas we had, so for now it's not something we are thinking of.

[h3][b]Will the difficulty settings of the game expanded beyond hunger and thirst meters depletion rate?[/b][/h3]
From: [UA]Ramiel [Steam]

[TW] They already kind of do. Currently, the difficulty settings also impact the penalty for your character dying with the amount of resources you lose, and the viral infection effects. But overall, yes we do plan to expand that list when it makes sense once we continue adding more features into the game that can impact difficulty.

[h3][b]Would you be willing to give the public access to a Trello board in a similar fashion to what Unknown Worlds did while subnautica was in development. This would give us insight into things that are currently being worked on as well as future plans.[/b][/h3]
From: Diavel [Steam]

[TW] This is something we actually talked about internally for a while now and we're currently looking at some tools that will allow us to both share the roadmap as well as gather feedback from community about planned features. Unfortunately we don't have a timeline for when it would go live just yet.

[h3][b]Can we please be able to move a storage crate around without emptying it?[/b][/h3]
From: KGI [Steam]

[AB] We've heard this quite a few times and it's a feature on our internal to-do list. There are a lot of underlying systems that need to be reworked to get this functioning properly without breaking the game or opening up the possibility for resource glitches. So rest assured, we're on it, just give us some time to figure this beast out. Eventually, the nightmare of moving objects from one box to another will hopefully just be a distant memory.

[h3][b]Will the world change when you progress in the story? Like dust disappearing ect.[/b][/h3]
From: Konna84 [Steam]

[AB] Yes, we have plans to create world progression. The world will change in terms of environment and locations as you achieve certain points of progression. One thing worth noting and this is something we have said from the start - our story is not going to be about you saving the world and undoing the ecological collapse of the world. The fate of the world was sealed by humanity’s actions and inactions. So this won’t be some Hollywood-style, hero-saves-the-world deal. Your goal is to try find a cure for the remaining human population who as a last-ditch effort, fled into orbit but did so not knowing they were infected with something that evolved due to the highly polluted environment.

[h3][b]Will there be QoL features? for example, instead of crafting 1 of each material, can we get a crafting queue for fabricators etc?[/b][/h3]
From: DankMeme_sys [Steam]

[TW] Yes of course. We will be introducing multiple QoL improvements throughout the EA period. The main thing is rememeber is to talk to us. The more we see a certain request the more we know this needs to be looked at.

[h3][b]Would putting in a 3rd person camera for building be an option?[/b][/h3]
From: Alpha_pyxis [Steam]

[AB] We've seen this request a few times but as of right now, we have no immidiate plans for this. This may seem like a simple change but there is so much that this impacts and until we a re closer to being feature complete, I don't think we will be dealing with this.

[h3][b]I'm an absolute sucker for some good lore and secrets, will there be any expanding upon the scribbles Noah left on the walls? Will this connect to something greater that we can look forward to uncovering, or was this just some visual spice?[/b][/h3]
From: Kampko [Steam]

[AB] 100% more story and lore will be added as we progress with the development. We ourselves our fans of survival games with story and lore so Forever Skies was always going to have an overall story to keep driving the player. Actually, the next update will have a bit more story revealed in it, but we will likely finish the story at the end of Early Access.

[h3][b]In the early game, dealing with food and water is excessively time consuming and altogether too frequent. Do you have plans to adjust this or put settings in the game to allow players to adjust it? [/b][/h3]
From: Hydroculator [Steam]

[TW] We'll be balancing difficulty levels more for sure, but also we will giving you more ways to get food and water intake - like more efficient cooking devices for example. So the hunger and thirst will eventually become a challnge you beat through gameplay.

[h3][b]Could we get a lightning rod attachment and then have a station inside our airships to recharge depleted batteries?[/b][/h3]
From: SteelThunder [Steam]

[AB] We prototyped a lightning rod early on in production, so yes theres a chance it might see the light of day in the future, for sure!

[h3][b]Would you consider adding some more verticality of movement when on foot? Such as a grappling hook to ge to harder to reach areas[/b][/h3]
From: VENGEANCE [Steam]

[AB] No plans just yet but never say never. It's definitely possible in the future.

[h3][b]How will the current gameplay loop be affected by multiple players?[/b][/h3]
From: MoriartyAvalon [Reddit]

[TW] It's a bit too early for us to reveal any significant information about co-op. But because the game was always going to have co-op, every design decision we make at some point goes through the “Ok, but how will this work in co-op” gauntlet of discussions. So things at this stage are still changing and adapting based on these conversations and checks.

[h3][b]Coffee update when?[/b][/h3]
From: K.C.Wiley [Twitter - [i]you won't catch us calling it "X"[/i]]

[TW] Unfortunately, you can't make coffee out of the coffee nut. Spoiler alert, that's actually the big reveal at the end of our story. The world ended because coffee couldn’t grow anymore so everyone just gave up :P  EDIT: I have been told by [strike]The Fun Police[/strike] [b]some people in marketing[/b] I need to point out this is a joke.

Thank you again to our community for all of your questions. We will hold another AMA in the future!

Thats all for now, have a great weekend!
- The Far From Home Team

notes.title: Small Content Patch, Game Sale, and Future Update Sneak Peek
notes.content:
Hello Scientists

A quick round-up of some things we want to share.

[list][*] We added a small content patch for you
[*] The game is currently on sale for 20% off
[*] First look at things we’re working on for our next big update[/list]

[h2]Small Content Update and Next Patch ETA. [/h2]

For those with a keen eye, we did a very small patch to the game. This was originally meant to be a standard patch with a few quality-of-life updates, bug fixes, and some additional in-game posters added-in to wrap it all up.

However, our eagle-eyed QA team caught a few instances of something that might impact a few players with more advanced airship builds. So it was decided to run more tests before committing the fixes, but because we already had these posters ready, we thought we might as well put them into the game. It’s a quick and easy thing to add so no point waiting. 

So there are now 10 additional posters that will randomly spawn into locations for you to find and spruce up your little home above the toxic dust. Here is a look at 3 so as not to spoil all the fun.

notes.title: Your Questions Answered | Part One
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings scientists![/h2]

A few weeks ago, we sent out a request for your AMA questions. And to say you guys delivered is a [b]massive[/b] understatement! So much so, that we have decided that we simply need to do another round to answer as many questions as possible!

So for now we have a bunch of your questions from Steam, Discord, Reddit & Twitter answered below by Gameplay Lead, Andrzej Blumenfeld [i][AB[/i]] and Creative Director, Tomek Wlazlo [[i]TW[/i]]. Then next week, we will follow up with Part Two!

[h3]So let's begin![/h3]

[h3][b]What kind of updates should we expect in terms of size/scope and frequency when it comes to content?[/b][/h3]
From: Alexander Lorular [Discord]

[TW] [i]As we stated on our Flight Map (Road Map) we plan to add larger updates every 3-4 months. With smaller Patches and Hotfixes in between. We've added our flight map below for reference.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/9bb1552e3379268b8e5fb43d256a862978a6c856.png[/img]

[h3][b]Is there a yearly quarter we can look forward to coop support?[/b][/h3]
From: iAmCursed [Discord]

[i][AB] We do not have a set date because we want to do it right and have it work properly with other features we have in place and planned for later. Co-op is a priority feature so it's a matter of when, but we won't rush it out till we're happy with it.[/i]

[h3][b]Will the airship garden be indoor/outdoor or both? What kind of plants can we grow and will we be able to get the plant's seeds for growing?[/b][/h3]
From: MedicalRider [Discord]

[i][TW] We're still working on this so we don't want to give away too much till we settle on the final ideas. What I can tell you is that the first iteration of gardening was purely indoors but this system has shown so much potential that we would love to develop much further. It's possible that we'll be adding new types of plants, devices, planters etc even after the gardening update.[/i]

[h3][b]How do POI (point of interest) spawns work? Are you guaranteed a chance to collect all the related collectibles?[/b][/h3]
From: NettlesomeCodger [Discord]

[i][TW] There are spots on the map where a POI can be generated using a procedurally generated tile system. The Generator chooses POI's randomly so it spawns in a different order and in a different location for each player. But the items won't stop spawning until the player collects the related objects, so don't worry! [/i]

[h3][b]Will there be different types of arrows for the crossbow?[/b][/h3]
From: MedicalRider [Discord]

[i][AB] We would love to add more types of bolts - we even have some ideas and prototypes for them so stay tuned.[/i]

[h3][b]When multiplayer is released, will each player have their own airship or will everyone share the same airship?[/b][/h3]
From: Tr3ntzilla [Discord]

[i][AB] Our plan from day one has always been one airship, shared between four players. One Captain (server host) with three crew members. The world and mechanics of Forever Skies have been designed around this core concept. However, we're also aware of the communities desire to have more than one airship. We're unable to make any promises right here and now only to have our plans change. It's not as easy as simply adding more airships. There are a lot of moving parts to these systems. But we're listening to you and its certainly something that requires further testing in the studio.[/i]

[h3][b]Will there be more biomes and locations in the future for above and below the dust?[/b][/h3]
From: Bagmann [Discord]

[i][TW]There will be more location types that's certain. As it comes to the biomes there are possibilities for that - the world of FS is vast, and we have a lot of cool ideas in the studio we want to explore here.[/i]

[h3][b]When can we pet the bug?[/b][/h3]
From: ewoudje [Discord]

[TW] [i]As soon as possible! No set date yet, but don't worry, we're working on it![/i]

[h3][b]Will there be a reason to descend into the dust with your airship, despite the damage the dust causes? [/b][/h3]
From: Entirago [Discord]

[i][AB] Yes! We really love the idea of a location or a location variant that is super close to the top of the dust layer. The oxygen timer would be a cool mechanic that could also be at play here. Hopefully this is something we might add in the future![/i]

[h3][b]Hi, love the game. I was wondering if there is planned support for resolutions above 1080p?[/b][/h3]
From: ian boy [Discord]

[i][TW] Yes, we do plan to support past 1080p. No current timeframes to share at the minute though but it is on the "to-do" list as a priority.[/i]

[h3][b]How happy is the team with how the game functions currently, and how likely are we to see reworks of things in the game?[/b][/h3]
From: Bagmann [Discord]

[TW] [i]As a developer you are never really happy with the results. You could tweak and improve things for an infinite amount of time and never be fully satisfied. But overall we see the game plays really well. We've already done some tweaks in balance and the survival system based on feedback, and we're adding more threats, content, and systems as we speak. We are also not against totally changing the way something works if we see the majority of the community want it so. The most important part for us is your feedback - this game is for you after all.[/i]

[h3][b]Will Forever Skies get mod support with workshop?[/b][/h3]
From: katz9997 [Steam]

[AB] [i]We want to say yes, but the question of how is still something we are looking into, so right now it's a maybe. We love the idea of mods as it gives players the ability to flex their creativity beyond the constraints of what we created. It also gives people a reason to keep coming back to our game, so there is very little downside in our eyes. We just need time to figure this out better, so watch this space.[/i]

[h3][b] Will Forever Skies support VR?[/b][/h3]
From: csfMaddin [Steam]

[TW] [i]We have no current plans for VR, but we're open to the idea and have even done some of our own minor internal tests out of sheer curiosity. The main thing here is that if we are going to do a VR version, we have to do it right either by ourselves or with a trusted VR partner. And to do that we'd need to have the game feature complete as we can't have a VR version of the game impacting what we want to create for the PC and console version.[/i]

[h3][b]Will changes be made regarding diseases? If so, do you care to share what those will be?[/b][/h3]
From: NukeAJS [Steam]

[AB] [i]Yes! There will be more diseases and they will play a much more significant role in the game. There will be new sources of viruses, new devices, new ways of treating them, and even some changes in the way our health system works. Stay tuned - it's coming really soon![/i]

[h3][b]Will there be a system put in place in the future to further augment our character? What I mean is we have a slot to put in better oxygen tanks, but what about extra slots for things like body armor, leg and arm augments[/b][/h3]
From: suikodudeman007 [Steam]

[TW] [i]We love this idea and it's certainly possible! It was a cool addition in Subnautica having special suits for specific areas/biomes. We have a few ideas knocking around at the minute, but no promises just yet. It's all about time and prioritizing what the game needs most.[/i]

[h3][b]Will we be able to build on the landing zones (ie. windmills, surface elevators)? I love the idea of making outposts and things and having places to come back to.[/b][/h3]
From: AgentSrell777 [Steam]

[AB] [i]This is highly unlikely to happen. Due to the world of Forever Skies being procedurally generated, locations currently despawn once you fly a set distance away from them, meaning anything you hypothetically built would be lost. So to implement an idea like this would require us to first strip out a fundamental tech solution we have in place that works in tandem with other big features.[/i]

[h3][b]Are there going to be a larger variation of airship building parts so it can look less boxy and have a greater possibility for creative builds?[/b][/h3]
From: Dersh [Steam]

[TW] [i]Yes, there are plans for more custom parts, similar to the Glass Corner modules that look more sleek.[/i]

[h3][b]Is this game's danger level going to remain the same or will we have more threats?[/b][/h3]
From: Crucible [Steam]

[AB] [i]There will be more threats added both above and below the dust. Some are coming very soon too.[/i]

[h3][b]Plans for future flying threats?[/b][/h3]
From: DeltaTwoZero [Steam]

[TW] [i]Yes! Among many, we're prototyping a floating plant colony that will damage the airship and infect the player. Here is a sneak peak! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/41f5f1ecf19dbc373ae5b78fc2d562660a3deb4e.png[/img]

[h3][b]We currently have rotate, do you plan to add Flip & Invert for object placement? I want an upside down Cockpit like we saw in pre-alpha[/b][/h3]
From: DeLindsay [Steam]

[TW] [i]Flipping and inverting every object could break the game in so many places so for the sake of our QA team's sanity, we are likely not going to add this. But we do plan to add additional airship parts, including the Inverted Cockpit[/i]

[h3][b]I know it's a long shot, but can you give us some insight into how combat is expected to be introduced and what it will look like?[/b][/h3]
From: K.C.Wiley [Twitter]

[AB] [i]Combat will be kept simple. After all, it's not a game about fighting, we're scientists, so killing will be a last resort. The Crossbow and Knife will be the tools you use as weapons, but players can use boosters to help themselves with tough situations too. Basically, we don't want players to expect to go "fully Rambo" in Forever Skies. Above that, we have no specifics ready to share with you about how combat will be introduced just yet as we ourselves are still testing out a few ideas[/i].

[h3][b]When will console players get to enjoy the skies?[/b][/h3]
From: Luke Reich [Twitter]

[AB] [i]We know console players are excited about Forever Skies, which is great! We have no set dates yet. But we will come to current-gen consoles after Early Access and we plan to be in Early Access at least for another 12 months.[/i]

[h3][b]Will there be more cutscenes like the one at the end of early access? It was fire.[/b][/h3]
From: Ettore Lignelli [Twitter]

[TW] [i]Yes there will be more of them, we're really glad you liked them![/i]

[h3][b]Will there be a Freebuild or Creative Mode in the future?[/b][/h3]
From: DeLindsay [Reddit]

[AB] [i]Yes, we do plan to add a creative mode later in Early Access at some point. It's something a few people have asked for and it's very clear to us why. We just need the time to get this done.[/i]


[h3][b]Are there any dev tools you plan to make available to users? Functions like “hide GUI/HUD”, “fly (or detach camera)”, or maybe commands for weather manipulation?[/b][/h3]
From: lieutenatdan [Reddit]

[TW] [i]HUD removal is something we plan to add for sure so it's a matter of when. As for the other dev tools, it is possible but it's unlikely to happen until much later when we have all our systems wrapped and in place.[/i]

-------------------------------------------------------

That's all the answers we have for now! As we mentioned before, we will post a Part Two at some point next week, so keep your eyes out ready for more dev answers!

Once again, thank you to our amazing community for your amazing questions!

Speak soon!
- Team Far From Home

notes.title: EA.1.0.2 Info and Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings scientists!

The first Forever Skies patch is here! Below we have spotlighted some of the highlights of the update and also the full patch notes!

[h2]NEW LOCATION: HIGH POINT[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/e5e1137492cc133b8775e606dd1dd3ef2f2485ff.gif[/img]

A new Wind Farm variant can now be found in Forever Skies, called High Point. This new variant contains not one, but TWO new tech items for players to discover and research. Both of which have been highly requested. You will need to reach a very high altitude to gain access to the entirety of this location.
[h2]
NEW TECH: DOCKING PLANK[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/3c441181a7f1f69aad022a29de28f09f5b50788c.gif[/img]

The first piece of tech you will find here is the blueprints for the Docking Plank. A useful tool for landing in hard-to-reach areas, and especially useful for players with large Airships who can no longer land their floating behemoths in the traditional manner.

Extend the catwalk to the desired length, and adjust the position as high or as low as you need. This new item makes landing at locations much easier.

But there is more to find here…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/5ffc6f89156da7f7ad17d474fc9b5744f2622fd8.gif[/img]

As well as all of the usual loot you would expect to find at Wind Farms, there is one more item to find here. And it’s the answer to one of the most highly requested additions since we launched into Early Access…

[h2]NEW TECH: RECYCLER[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/5e265b17f9ee8a698c602cb4d6dd8da78c86482e.gif[/img]

It exists! And it's coming to the First Ascent update. Got any old Small Storage Boxes or Glass Bottles you want to recycle back into raw materials? Well, now you can with the handy Recycler. Just place the item you want to recycle in the box and after a short moment, the basic materials will be presented to the player on a 360-degree rotation device.

This machine wouldn’t have been possible without your feedback, so let us know what you think of the design!

[h2]CHANGES TO INVENTORY:[/h2]

To put it simply, we’re increasing inventory size by 25%. Some items will now stack that didn’t before, like battery types. And total stack quantities are also being increased too. More details below:

Extractable item stacks have increased from 50 to 100 
Picked-up item stacks have increased from 20 to 25 
Rare pick-up items have increased from 5 to 10 
[h3]
But that's not all… [/h3]

We’ve also increased the number of slots for the Small Storage Boxes & Hanging Shelves.  
Finally, we've reduced the cost of fabricating certain Pickup items like Machine Parts & Plastic Scraps! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/fe5262dc2da0ae55f770d6da298258421eadf9c8.png[/img]

[h2]NEW COLOURS FOR THE PAINT TOOL:[/h2]

This one is pretty self-explanatory, more colours are coming. We have also fixed the spawn rate of Petit Astre plants. Meaning crafting Cartridges will be easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/274acd4ab05a802b853cb7cfd1e5e459743254c6.png[/img]

[h2]NEW TECH UPGRADE: ADVANCED AUTO-EXTRACTOR[/h2]

The final new item we’re showcasing is the Upgraded Auto-Extractor. Thanks to your feedback about the basic model, we decided to create an advanced model, that included some of the features that you guys requested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/f859ca9a5033b25cdb768d42e4bcc86d854cfe4e.png[/img]

Players now have more control over the tool:

- The ability to filter what extractable resources are collected 
- Assign up to 4 containers (or none at all) for one specific resource 
- The ability to save power by turning off the Extractor when it's not needed 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/1431ddb3398a8bfa94f97c346b8966cfae48b0cb.png[/img]

To get this upgraded model on board your airship, you will need to find and secure the blueprints for it first! Have fun, scientists.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]PATCH NOTES:[/h2]

[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
- New Location - High Point Wind Farm
- New Device - Docking Plank
- New Device - Recycler
- New Device - Filtering Deck Extractor
- New Artifacts
- Visited locations become greyed out on the Radar after players collect the battery from the location
- Removed suit VO on immunity raising/decreasing
- Water Condenser trigger can be used regardless of the angle
- Automated Deck Extractor & Filtering Deck Extractor - added Power On/Off option
- Fabricator is added as research to conduct on the Research Station
- Extracting metal plates on the Lift location is saved
- Fewer Repair Patches spawned on locations
- The Upgraded Tool Charger is now in the Upgrade Station and takes a Tool Charger to craft
- Both Tool Chargers can now charge any tool
- Improved player guidance to Automatic Deck Extractor Wreck & Paint Tool location

[h3]STACKS SIZE & RESOURCES BALANCE[/h3]
- Bigger stacks of some resources
- Added batteries stacking
- Small Storage & Hanging Shelves have more space inside
- Reduced price of some crafted materials
- Fat and Glowing Moths nutrition parameters tweak

[h3]GAME SAVES[/h3]
- Reworked "Quit without saving" and "Save and quit" buttons into separate "Save" and "Quit" buttons in the pause menu. "Quit" now asks the player if they also want to save the game
- Auto-save settings should now retain their values between sessions

[h3]GRAPHIC SETTINGS[/h3]
- Added an option to set suggested graphics settings based on a hardware benchmark. This will run automatically for new players on the first launch. Existing players can find the option in the graphics settings

[h3]ACCESSIBILITY IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
- Screen shakes decreased with options for jumping and with using tools (decreasing motion sickness)
- Many more keys are now supported for input rebinding, including: Num0-Num9, math operators, Insert-PageDown block, and symbols common for AZERTY keyboard layouts. If we still don't support the keys you need, please let us know through the Send Feedback form
- Option to decrease Airship sway (decreasing motion sickness)
- Full Controller Support - the game is now fully playable with a controller.
*Note: If you have previously activated any Steam Controller Inputs, make sure to turn these off if you wish to play with a controller.  

[h3]STEAM - SETTINGS - CONTROLLER[/h3]
- Supported controllers:
Xbox One 
Xbox Series X 
DualSense 
DualShock4


[h3]LOCALISATION[/h3]
- Italian language added

[h3]FIXES[/h3]
- Fixed Petit Astre spawn on Garden locations - players will now be able to craft Painting Cartridges easier
- Fixed Garden Artifacts generation (they were not generated)
- Fixed an issue where some Paint Skins were not available in Memory Cards
- Fixed an issue where Corner Observatory was unlocked way later than it should in Memory Cards
- Fixed sleeping menu > Now the background should cover the whole screen
- Fixed several gamepad-specific bugs in menus and inventory
- Fixed a rare crash related to using F11 to toggle fullscreen
- Fixed a rare crash at the game launch related to analytics
- Fixed a bug with Water Condenser not being usable when you inserted a new membrane without taking out the water

[h3]OTHER CHANGES[/h3]
- Version number added to the main menu
- Added death screen on permadeath that leads the player to the main menu and erases all saves for that play through
- Credits update

[h3]KNOWN ISSUES[/h3]
- The note requires keyboard input to write text
- The quick move doesn't work for liquids in a bottle

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Speak soon,
Team Far From Home

notes.title: Forever Skies Test Branch Now Open | Test Upcoming Patch Content
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Scientists.[/h2]

Some exciting news!

[h3][b]We are opening a special Forever Skies Test Branch that will give players access to the upcoming patch before it is added to the main game. [/b][/h3]

We have been getting quite a few requests from players about the possibility to test and feedback updates as for many of you, this is the part of Early Access that you enjoy the most – seeing how things change, develop, and having a say in how things shape up.

The test branch is designed to gather feedback, identify potential issues, and make necessary improvements before the official release. So please do consider taking part only if you believe you will have time to test and submit feedback. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/70f1c51887221428a16c030d43dbfcaf4ad7a3ed.gif[/img]
(New Docking Plank Device)

[h2]Open to All Owners of the Game + Share and Discuss Freely[/h2]

The Test Branch will work for anyone who owns a copy of Forever Skies. You are also all welcome to share and talk about anything you encounter on the Test Branch freely. No NDAs are required. 

[h2]No Content is Set in Stone[/h2]

Any content encountered in the Test Branch is still subject to change after testing. 

[h2]Existing Saves Won’t be Affected but use an Imported Save To Play the Test Branch[/h2]

Your existing saves, progress, and any custom settings you’ve set in from the main game won’t be carried over to the Test Branch. Your pc will see this as if you are installing and playing the game for the first time ever. Likewise, by playing on the Test Branch, your main saves should not be affected at all.

This also means any progress on the test branch will not be carried over to the main game once the update is live. The test branch is designed to allow you to explore and test new features without impacting your current progress.

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. Instructions on how to do it can be found below.  

[h2][h1]How To Access the Test Branch[/h1][/h2]

[list]
[*] Open the Steam application on your PC and locate Forever Skies in your games library
[*] Right click - PROPERTIES- BETAS
[*] Put in the password: [i][b]BlimpWorkshop[/b][/i]
[*] From the dropdown menu select the beta branch tilted: beta_flight
[*] Press the blue “Opt into beta_flight…” button
[*] In your Games Library click on [b][i]Forever Skies [beta_flight][/i][/b]
[*] Install the Test Branch
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/77700a99e25b4c21ab3566232fdab27fd15820c0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/83781dbba7c3ee87d802ed3187589b8b2df9bc45.jpg[/img]

[h2]How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch[/h2]

Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:

[list]
[*] Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[i][b]C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\[/b][/i]
[*] Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
[*] Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
[i][b]C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\[/b][/i]
[*] Paste your copied save file into this location
[*] As a precaution make a 2nd copy of your save file and paste it somewhere on your desktop or in a safe folder. This way you can ensure you have a clean, backup save just in case.
[/list]

After you have done the above, you can start the Forever Skies Test Branch from Steam and your save will be present when you select “CONTINUE”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/5e265b17f9ee8a698c602cb4d6dd8da78c86482e.gif[/img]
(New Recycler Device)

[h2]Where to Submit Bugs[/h2]

All bugs or issues that you encounter while playing should be submitted via the FEEDBACK TOOL that you can find in-game when pausing the game. Subsequently, you can find the tool under this link too: 

[h3][url=https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests]https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests[/url][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/f859ca9a5033b25cdb768d42e4bcc86d854cfe4e.png[/img]
(New Auto Extractor Device)

We are immensely excited about working even more closely with our dedicated community to ensure that our updates and content align with your expectations. Thank you for your unwavering support and enthusiasm for Forever Skies and for wanting to help us shape the game together.

Below is the patch notes to give you a better idea of what to look out for. 

- The Far From Home Team
----------------------------------------------------

[h1]Patch Number: EA.1.0.2 List of Changes[/h1]

[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
New Location - High Point Wind Farm
New Device - Docking Plank
New Device - Recycler
New Device - Filtering Deck Extractor
New Artifacts
Visited locations become greyed out on the Radar after players collect the battery from the location
Removed suit VO on immunity raising/decreasing
Water Condenser trigger can be used regardless of the angle
Automated Deck Extractor & Filtering Deck Extractor - added Power On/Off option
Fabricator is added as research to conduct on the Research Station
Extracting metal plates on the Lift location is saved
Fewer Repair Patches spawned on locations
The Upgraded Tool Charger is now in the Upgrade Station and takes a Tool Charger to craft
Both Tool Chargers can now charge any tool
Improved player guidance to Automatic Deck Extractor Wreck & Paint Tool location

[h2]STACKS SIZE & RESOURCES BALANCE[/h2]
Bigger stacks of some resources
Added batteries stacking
Small Storage & Hanging Shelves have more space inside
Reduced price of some crafted materials
Fat and Glowing Moths nutrition parameters tweak

[h2]GAME SAVES[/h2]
Reworked "Quit without saving" and "Save and quit" buttons into separate "Save" and "Quit" buttons in the pause menu. "Quit" now asks the player if they also want to save the game
Auto-save settings should now retain their values between sessions

[h2]GRAPHIC SETTINGS[/h2]
Added an option to set suggested graphics settings based on a hardware benchmark. This will run automatically for new players on the first launch. Existing players can find the option in the graphics settings

[h2]ACCESSIBILITY IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
Screen shakes decreased with options for jumping and with using tools (decreasing motion sickness)
Many more keys are now supported for input rebinding, including: Num0-Num9, math operators, Insert-PageDown block, and symbols common for AZERTY keyboard layouts. If we still don't support the keys you need, please let us know through the Send Feedback form
Option to decrease Airship sway (decreasing motion sickness)
Full Controller Support - the game is now fully playable with a controller.

Supported controllers:
Xbox One 
Xbox Series X 
DualSense 
DualShock4

*Note: If you have previously activated any Steam Controller Inputs, make sure to turn these off if you wish to play with a controller.  STEAM - SETTINGS - CONTROLLER

[h2]LOCALISATION[/h2]
Italian language added

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
Fixed Petit Astre spawn on Garden locations - players will now be able to craft Painting Cartridges easier
Fixed Garden Artifacts generation (they were not generated)
Fixed an issue where some Paint Skins were not available in Memory Cards
Fixed an issue where Corner Observatory was unlocked way later than it should in Memory Cards
Fixed sleeping menu > Now the background should cover the whole screen
Fixed several gamepad-specific bugs in menus and inventory
Fixed a rare crash related to using F11 to toggle fullscreen
Fixed a rare crash at the game launch related to analytics

[h2]OTHER CHANGES[/h2]
Version number added to the main menu
Added death screen on permadeath that leads the player to the main menu and erases all saves for that play through
Credits update

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]
Filtering Deck Extractor doesn’t save filters after loading
The note requires keyboard input to write text
The quick move doesn't work for liquids in a bottle

notes.title: Next Patch Planned for First Half of July: Fixes, Balance Tweaks and New Content
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Scientists[/h2]

After about a week since our Early Access launch, we’ve been hard at work on our first patch which will bring a collection of fixes, improvements, and also some new content. We have been scouring feedback from our community and have pinpointed some tweaks and content requests that can be added relatively quickly, so instead of holding them for our larger planned content updates, we decided to add them into this upcoming patch.

We don’t want to give away the whole list right now as there is still a chance some things can be added or pushed to a later update if testing proves the need. However, we are excited to highlight one particular addition, especially for all those who have created some absolute beast-sized airships that have become a little more difficult to “park”. 

[h3][b]We will be adding a Docking Plank Device:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/70f1c51887221428a16c030d43dbfcaf4ad7a3ed.gif[/img]

Now you can safely float your hulking behemoth airship over to the sides of a tower, roll out your metal “red carpet” and walk over with full grace and dignity compared to what some of you are doing now.  

[b]Our goal is to have this patch developed, tested, and shipped by mid-July.[/b] 

You can expect a variety of changes, including balance tweaks, quality-of-life upgrades for tools, additional accessibility options, full controller support, and, of course, a few new devices and items to enhance your airship to name just a few.

See you in the skies.

[i]- Team Far From Home[/i]
